A Golden Empire.description: Enact a Golden Age as an Empire.
A Golden Empire.completion: Is in a golden era Is an empire
A Golden Empire.notes: The golden era can be started on the first day of the next month after completing 3 objectives. Easily done as Ming You begin as an empire, already have a 30-development capital, and have more than five centres of trade at the beginning, you just need to release five vassals and you can begin your golden era.

A Protected Market.notes: Easy to do as Aragon within 1-2 years. Move Aragon's capital (or main trade city, if you have Wealth of Nations) out of the Valencia trade node. Send a merchant to collect trade in Valencia. Then grant the Burghers the 'Exclusive Trade Rights' privilege, that grants 3 immediate mercantilism. Without unpausing, recall your merchant from Valencia. Unpause, and the privilege will be revoked due to there not being a trade node where you own 3 centers of trade and are collecting. The player can then send the merchant to Valencia again, give the privilege and recall the merchant. Repeat this process until 100% mercantilism is reached. Alternatively, this process can be done with any nation that has 3 centers of trade in any trade node and at least one province in a node that the nation does not own 3 centers of trade. Some nations this method can be applied to at the 1444 start date include Castile , England , Tunis , Poland , Ming and Vijayanagar

AAA Credit.description: As a Great Power, take on over 1,000 ducats of another nation’s debt.
AAA Credit.completion: Is a Great power Has taken on 1000 ducats of another country's debt.
AAA Credit.notes: Must be done in a single action

All That's Thine Shall Be Mine.description: As a Greedy ruler, take all of a nation’s ducats in a peace deal.
All That's Thine Shall Be Mine.completion: Took all of an enemy nation's ducats in a peace deal, during the reign of a Greedy Ruler.
All That's Thine Shall Be Mine.notes: Can be achieved without being the warleader by having a Greedy ruler and the warleader taking all of a nation's ducats in a peace deal. The rulers of Amago , Cleves , Cologne , Hatakeyama , Isshiki , Khandesh , Lüneburg and Otomo are greedy at the start of the game.

Cold War.description: Win a war without fighting a single battle.
Cold War.completion: Won one war without fighting a single battle.
Cold War.notes: Start as a neighbor of an OPM. Go to a total war with them and sign peace (break their alliances if needed and take all their money). Soon after declare another war (breaking the truce) and capture their undefended capital. Naval battles do not prevent the achievement.

Combined Arms.description: Have both an Admiral and a General with a trait.
Combined Arms.completion: Have an Admiral with a trait Have a General with a trait
Combined Arms.notes: Conquistadors and explorers do not count. Leaders gain traits at the end of battles with a chance based on the military tradition gain from that battle, which is based (in part) on the number of losses inflicted on the enemy. The Ottomans and France start with a general with a trait in 1444.

Cowardly Tactics.description: Have a fort and a supply depot in a mountainous province producing livestock.
Cowardly Tactics.completion: Own and control a livestock-producing mountain province with a fort building and a supply depot
Cowardly Tactics.notes: Easily done as Mamluks or the Three Leagues , who start with a fort on a livestock producing mountain province and 10% army professionalism.

Czechs and Balances.description: Starting as Bohemia, grant at least two privileges to each estate while having at least 50% Crown Land.
Czechs and Balances.completion: At least two privileges are granted to the Clergy At least two privileges are granted to the Burghers At least two privileges are granted to the Nobility Land owned by the crown is at least 50%
Czechs and Balances.notes: This can be done easily by starting as Bohemia and then releasing Moravia as a vassal and selecting the option to play as the released vassal. Afterwards, you'll have more than 80% Crown Land and now you can give 2 privileges to each estate. Several of the privileges do not affect the size of the Crown Land which makes it easy to stay above 50.

Defender of the Faith.notes: Can be done immediately as Ottomans , just take out a few loans and claim the title.

Double the Love.description: Start with no unions and get two at the same time.
Double the Love.notes: This does not mean inheriting two personal unions simultaneously, only that a country starting with no personal unions eventually holds two at the same time. Brandenburg gains a union over AI Ansbach by event when their starting heir succeeds to the throne, inheriting Ansbach's own union over Bayreuth Muscovy can claim the thrones of Tver and Ryazan Castile can get a union over Aragon and Naples if the Iberian Wedding occurs while Aragon maintained their union with Naples or got a union over Navarra from the event “ The Death of King Alfonso ” Castile can also get a Restoration of Union CB against Portugal from their missions. Poland and Austria can get Restoration of Union CBs through events or missions (and Poland can reliably get a union with Lithuania by event).

Factionalism.description: Have 3 different estates in your country with at least 70% influence each.

For the Glory.notes: Start as Ayutthaya , then annex either of their vassals after 10 years. Also easy with Denmark which can annex its vassal Holstein

Foul Mouthed.description: Scornfully insult 10 nations that border you.
Foul Mouthed.completion: At least 10 neighbouring countries have the “Scornfully Insulted” opinion modifier towards you
Foul Mouthed.notes: The 10 countries must all have the opinion modifier at the same time. Lithuania borders 11 nations at the start of game. Very easy in 1.32. Keep giving the burgers the Patronage of the Arts privilege then revoke it and give it again. Giving it three times puts you over 50 prestige. Then scornfully insult 10 of Lithuania's 11 neighbours.

From Humble Origins.description: Starting as a custom nation with no more than 50 points, have at least 2000 total development.
From Humble Origins.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Has at least 2000 total development
From Humble Origins.notes: It is possible to create a custom nation with 2000 development with only 50 points, although it is very tedious to do so. First, select a capital within Central Asia, be a duchy. Get the worst possible ruler, heir, and consort, and make them as young as possible. Then, you should pick the ideas that cost negative points , from most negative points to least (they are found under administrative ideas). You should be left with three idea slots, which you should fill with administrative ideas that cost no points. Finally, take all provinces with the lowest terrain multiplier until you have 2000 development. Avoid taking provinces with gold or trade bonuses, since they will cost more. Example save with such nation Can also be paired with For Odin! and Ideas Guy

Full House.description: Have 3 Vassals and 2 Marches at the same time.
Full House.notes: Can be done immediately as Muscovy or Timurids They start with 5 vassals in 1444; simply designate two as marches.

Gentle Persuasion.description: Have a Siege Specialist general win a siege in a province with a fort.
Gentle Persuasion.completion: Won a siege against a fort using a General with the Siege Specialist trait.
Gentle Persuasion.notes: Easily done as France as they begin with a siege specialist general.

Imposter Syndrome.description: As Sus, have three countries hostile to you (less than 0 opinion) after they discovered your spy.
Imposter Syndrome.completion: Is Sus Three countries fulfill the following conditions: have a negative opinion of this country have the opinion modifier “ Did Covert Actions ”  towards this country
Imposter Syndrome.notes: Being a subject of Morocco does not prevent you from spying on other countries and independence is therefore not required. You simply need to use your two diplomats to build spy network in any country. There is about an 85% chance three nations will discover your spies within the first ten years. If your relations with them are still positive, insult them. Before unpausing the game, search for the countries with starting rulers with Secretive personality which gives +20% foreign spy detection.

Isn't this the way to India?.description: Discover the Americas as Castile or Spain.
Isn't this the way to India?.completion: Has discovered North America and South America
Isn't this the way to India?.notes: Remove the terra incognita of 1 province in the continent of South America and 1 province in the continent of North America.

It's all about the money.notes: Easily done as a big nation by taking loans until reaching the target.

Liberty or Death.description: Start as USA in 1776 bookmark and own all your cores while being at peace.
Liberty or Death.completion: Not at war United States : Owns all core provinces
Liberty or Death.notes: Can be done easily by signing a peace treaty and accepting any demands. Then revoke all the cores of the provinces given away.

Krabater.description: Form the nation of Croatia and station a unit of cavalry in Stockholm.
Krabater.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Croatia Station a unit of cavalry in Stockholm.
Krabater.notes: Croatia doesn't actually have to be formed for the achievement. All you have to do to get this achievement is to start as Croatia, ask for military access from Sweden, load your starting cavalry regiment onto a transport, then sail up next to Stockholm and move your cavalry onto it.

Marshy March.description: Have a march with at least two marsh provinces.
Marshy March.completion: Have a march with at least two marsh provinces
Marshy March.notes: Easily done as Mushasha , simply release Basra and make them a march.

Narcissism.description: Name a general after yourself and lead your army to victory.
Narcissism.completion: Either An army is led by a general with the player's Steam name Win a battle with a general with the player's Steam name or Has a leader named after one of the following VIPs - “DDRJake”, “Duplo”, “neondt”, “StarNaN”, “The French Paradox”, “Bus”, “Groogy”, “mikesc”, “PDJR_Alastorn”, “Ofaloaf”, “Caligula Caesar”, “Imse”, “KaiserJohan”, “Hawky”, “Johan”, “Pavía”, “Aldaron”, “SaintDaveUK”, “Gnivom”, “Big Boss”, “Comrade Flan”, “CzerstfyChlep”, “Pintu” or “Rossarness”
Narcissism.notes: Is only visible with the Cradle of Civilization, but can be completed without that DLC by editing the player's Steam name to match the name of a general. Or by creating a custom nation with a monarch with the exact name as the player's Steam name and make him a general and win a battle with him. Or by using “Caligula” as the first name and “Caesar” as the dynasty of a ruler in a custom nation (or one of the other two word names).

Not so sad a state....description: As Portugal, have a colony in Brazil and in Africa.
Not so sad a state....completion: Have an unfinished colony in both Brazil and in the continent of Africa
Not so sad a state....notes: Establish two colonies in Brazil and in Africa. Keep in mind the colonies need to be established, not finished, so this can be done extremely quickly after unlocking the first two exploration ideas.

Populists in Government.description: Switch government type through government reforms.
Populists in Government.completion: Has switched government type via a government reform
Populists in Government.notes: Fastest as a tribal nation, as only 5 reforms are needed to change government type.

Pyramid of Skulls.description: As a Steppe Horde, raze a province with at least 30 development.
Pyramid of Skulls.completion: Is steppe nomad Razed a province of at least 30 development.
Pyramid of Skulls.notes: The eligible provinces in 1444 are Nanjing (33), Beijing (31) and Constantinople after Ottoman conquest (34), although it is much easier to conquer a good province from a minor, develop it to 30, give it back, conquer again and finally raze it. The easiest way is to start as Uzbek , increase development in Qaraqalpak (440), release Khiva as vassal (one province), declare war and conquer the province. This can even be done without a war by giving a 30 dev province to a vassal an then seizing it. Uzbek can use Kypshak (476) for this, because it starts with 18 dev and then give it to Sibir , because they are easy to keep loyal.

Queen of Conquest.description: Conquer land while in a Queen Regency.
Queen of Conquest.completion: Have a consort regency with a female consort Conquered land

Seriously?!.completion: Have killed 10 000 men in one battle.

Subsidize my Love.description: Subsidize 3 different allies at least 50% of their monthly income without running a deficit.
Subsidize my Love.completion: Does not have negative monthly income Have 3 allies that are subsidized at least 50%.
Subsidize my Love.notes: The subsidies also count as income, so the subsidies have to be as high as the total income before the subsidies. The total income can be seen in the Income Comparison page in the ledger. The Country page doesn't show all income sources. Easily done as England with the Irish minors or as Austria with HRE OPMs.

Tear Down This Wall.completion: Has used artillery barrage on Berlin.
Tear Down This Wall.notes: As Brandenburg, wait until you have military technology 7. Recruit at least 3 units of artillery, mothball the fort of Berlin then tank your legitimacy by dishineriting heirs and abdicating. Pretender rebels will siege it down, you can then attack and barrage it.

That's a Grand Army.description: Build up your army to your country's maximum army forcelimit.
That's a Grand Army.completion: Have an army size that is 99% of maximum force limit
That's a Grand Army.notes: This achievement is not awarded if the player plays a nation that already is at or is over its maximum force limit.

That's a Grand Navy.description: Build up your navy to your country's maximum navy forcelimit.
That's a Grand Navy.completion: Have a navy size that is 99% of maximum force limit

The Continuation of Diplomacy.description: Successfully use Threaten War to gain a province from another nation.
The Continuation of Diplomacy.completion: Have acquired a province through threatening war.
The Continuation of Diplomacy.notes: Easily done as Ming after fabricating a claim on either Kham or Korchin

The Six Nations.description: Form a Federation of at least six nations as the Iroquois.
The Six Nations.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Primary culture is Iroquois Is leader of a federation with six nations in it
The Six Nations.notes: Easily done as Onondaga by inviting a nation to your federation on day one.

This is My Faith.description: Convert to Protestantism and unlock 3 Aspects of Faith.
This is My Faith.completion: Is Protestant Have 3 aspects of faith
This is My Faith.notes: Bohemia, the nations in the British Isles and those in Scandinavia start in a great position for this achievement.

Three Trivial Tributary Tribes.completion: Has 3 Tributary States with government type tribal or native
Three Trivial Tributary Tribes.notes: Easily done as Ming at the start of the campaign. Simply loading up an ironman campaign of Ming will immediately grant the achievement, as they meet the requirements on 11 November 1444. The possible first government reforms include, but are not limited to: Steppe Nomads , Tribal Despotism , Tribal Monarchy , Tribal Federation , Tribal Democracy , and Siberian Clan Council The government type mapmode can be used to identify countries of the correct government type.

Time Bandit.description: Successfully steal a map from another nation.
Time Bandit.completion: Stole a map from another country.

True Catholic.notes: The achievement only triggers if the number of player controlled cardinals is greater than or equal to (≥) 3. If the player starts with 2 or more cardinals the achievement will not be awarded. Easily done as Spain. Can be done immediately by starting as the Papal States and bribing 3 cardinals into your lands.

Truly Divine Ruler.completion: Have a ruler that has at least 5 skill in every category
Truly Divine Ruler.notes: Easiest way to obtain this achievement is starting with Poland and appoint a local noble ruler for the event. Alternatively, start as a republic and re-elect 4 times.

Until death do us apart.description: Secure a Royal Marriage with another country.
Until death do us apart.notes: Note that it won't trigger if the player already has one or more royal marriages at game start.

Victorious!.notes: Win a war as the main participant.

Voltaire's Nightmare.description: Have at least 100 countries in the HRE.
Voltaire's Nightmare.completion: At least 100 countries are members of the Holy Roman Empire
Voltaire's Nightmare.notes: Create a custom nation with your capital in the HRE (you could go for Triest) and give yourself provinces with releasable tags within and adjacent to the empire. Add all provinces to the empire and release all tags to instantly unlock the achievement. Expand Possible provinces are Dauphiné, Narbonnais, Rouergue, Auvergne, Castellón, Mallorca, Girona, Sasser, Corsica, Parma, Modena, Spoleto, Perugia, Bari, Friuli, Padova, Spalato, Corfu, Arta, Atene, Nasso, Rhodes, Creta, Sugla, Lienz, Unterkärnten, Hradiste, Ruppin, Rügen, Trencsén and Dolní Lužice.

A Pile of Gold.notes: In 1444, the Niger region has 3, the South Africa and East Africa regions have 5, the Peru and Upper Peru regions have 6, and the Mexico region has 10, so it is easiest as a nation like Aztec. Does not require provinces to be cored. Provinces owned by colonial nations do not count (but playing as a released colonial nation does). Expand All pre-determined gold provinces

Absolutely.notes: Sweden and Prussia have events to increase their maximum absolutism. France , Portugal , Sweden , and Russia have events, decisions, or ideas that give yearly absolutism gain. Every monarchy can achieve this with the base of 60 + 15 from 100% crownland + 25 from the three relevant government reforms.

Abu Bakr II’s Ambition.description: Start as Mali and have 4 Colonial Subjects in South America.
Abu Bakr II’s Ambition.completion: Have 4 colonial nations based in the continent of South America
Abu Bakr II’s Ambition.notes: All 4 colonies must have their capital on the South American continent. Colonial Colombia is partially in South America and North America and colonizing the NA lands may result in their capital being in NA.

All belongs to Mother Russia.description: Start as a country of Russian culture and form Russia.

An Industrial Evolution.description: As Great Britain, own all of England as core provinces and have at least 25 development in each province there.
An Industrial Evolution.completion: Not as a released vassal Is Great Britain Own and have cores on the London, East Midlands, West Midlands, East Anglia, Wessex, and Yorkshire areas with each province having at least 25 development. (The Northern England area is not needed.) Expand

At every continent.description: Own one province on each continent.
At every continent.completion: Own a province in each of the 6 continents
At every continent.notes: The continents are: Europe, Asia, Africa, North America, South America and Oceania. Most easily done as Spain or Portugal , as they can colonize faster.

Azur semé de lis or.description: Get all the French Cores as France.
Azur semé de lis or.completion: All cored provinces are owned by France Expand
Azur semé de lis or.notes: Aside from reconquest, can also be done by revoking the cores from non-owned provinces

Baa Baa Black Sheep.description: As Qara Qoyunlu become the leading producer of wool.
Baa Baa Black Sheep.notes: You start with 5 wool-producing provinces. Focus solely on accumulating diplomatic points to develop them. Can be done before 1450. Alternatively, annexing Bitlis with 3 additional provinces will reduce the amount of developing needed (note that annexation can start as early as 1445 in this case). Annexing neighbouring OPM Hisn Kayfa also helps, as they produce wool.

Black Jack.description: Have at least 21 different subjects with 5 cities each and without any subject having 50% or more Liberty Desire. Trade Companies do not count.
Black Jack.completion: Has 21 different subjects with more than 5 cities and less than 50% liberty desire
Black Jack.notes: Can be easily achieved with Tributary states as the Chinese Emperor with the Mandate of Heaven DLC or Ashikaga with its daimyos. Can also be achieved by conquering swathes of low-development land and releasing client states.

Blockader.description: Blockade at least 10 ports of one enemy.
Blockader.completion: Blockade at least 10 enemy ports at the same time.
Blockader.notes: Easily done as the Ottomans with the Mamluks at the start of the campaign.

Blood for the Sky God!.description: As a Tengri nation, have Nahuatl as your syncretic faith.
Blood for the Sky God!.completion: Is Tengri Syncretic faith is Nahuatl
Blood for the Sky God!.notes: Start as a Jurchen tribe and choose Exploration ideas first. Conquer Eastern Siberia for colonial range to North America and colony-hop to Mesoamerica Do not form Qing

Brick by Brick.description: Starting as Denmark, enact the Unified Kalmar Monarchy government reform and own the entire Scandinavian region as your cores.
Brick by Brick.completion: Has enacted the Unified Kalmar Monarchy government reform Own and core all provinces in the Scandinavia region
Brick by Brick.notes: Make sure that you always have at least one junior partner in Scandinavia, because otherwise you will lose the starting reform Kalmar Union , because you can only get the reform Unified Kalmar Monarchy by completing the mission Ratify the Kalmar Union while having the reform Kalmar Union

Bright Spark.notes: Starting as Florence, only focus on technology and ideas, accept all events that give innovativeness and always choose the same leader during election, can be done before 1550.

Brothers in Arms.description: Win a war as a secondary participant.
Brothers in Arms.completion: Won a war without being the war leader.

Center of Attention.description: Own both a Protestant and a Reformed Center of Reformation.
Center of Attention.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Own a Protestant center of reformation Own a Reformed center of reformation
Center of Attention.notes: A random event creates the first Center of Reformation for each denomination. After that, the next two nations in Europe to convert have a random province designated as a Center of Reformation. Alternatively be on the first two to convert to Protestantism, and when you have a new monarch and Reformed has spawned, convert to Reformed.

Chop Chop.description: With only one Monarch, have six different Consorts.
Chop Chop.notes: As an Anglican nation, (a) Divorce Consort every 100 church power, then wait for a new consort; (b) royal marriage with another nation; or (c) press "Marry a local Noblewoman" button in religious panel. Cycle through the options five times. Disinherit the heir if necessary. Easily doable if the ruler is young.

Cities of Cibola.description: As a Nation that has Pueblo as primary culture, own at least 7 provinces with 10 development each.
Cities of Cibola.completion: Own 7 provinces with at least 10 development each
Cities of Cibola.notes: Need to reform your nation before you are able to manually develop provinces. Use Settle down reform to be able to own more then one province and settle tribal development into your provinces.

City of Cities.description: Own a core province with at least 60 development.
City of Cities.completion: Own and have core a city with at least 60 development
City of Cities.notes: Easiest to do as the Ottomans with Constantinople.

Colonial Management.description: Have 3 colonial governors that were directly appointed by you at the same time.
Colonial Management.completion: Appoint 3 colonial governors holding office in your colonies at the same time
Colonial Management.notes: “Replace Governor” is a subject action you may perform on your crown colonies.

David the Builder.description: As Georgia have no free building slots in any owned province.
David the Builder.completion: Is Georgia No owned provinces have a free building slot
David the Builder.notes: Playing or starting as Imereti is not required anymore. Can be done by filling the capital with buildings and then giving all other provinces to vassals. The capital Tbilisi starts with 3 building slots, so it may be preferable to move the capital to one of the Western provinces since they have only 2 available buildings slots, making it possible to fill with just a church and a marketplace (100 100 ducats each) at tech 4 in admin/dip. Can also be achieved by being fully annexed. Simply declare No-CB wars on your neighbors and surrender until you cease existing.

Die Please Die.description: Have a ruler with 1 or lower in all three categories who is over the age of 70.
Die Please Die.completion: Is not in a regency Have a ruler that: Has less than 2 in every Monarch power Has reached the age of 70 years
Die Please Die.notes: Mali 's and Kanem Bornu 's rulers are eligible. Very easy in 1.22 or earlier with Timurids ' 67 year old ruler. Karaman starts out with 1/0/0 leader and 0/0/1 heir that can also work.

Disciples of Enlightenment.description: Starting as Dai Viet, have 10 nations follow the Mahayana Faith by 1500.
Disciples of Enlightenment.completion: The year is before 1500 At least 10 nations follow the Mahayana faith
Disciples of Enlightenment.notes: Note that the player's country itself does count. Pahang and Pangasinan already start as Mahayana and Dai Viet itself also counts, effectively bringing down the requirement to 7, and the Philippine islands are an excellent place to start forcing conversions. You can release File:Annan.png Annan and Tonkin for two extra countries.

Down Under.notes: Easily done as one of the nations located in proximity to the region. Establish a colony on any province of the Australian coastline (no need to finish the colony). Taking someone's colony in Australia when signing peace or conquering natives won't earn the achievement.

Dude, Where's my Boat?.description: Capture 20 boats with the Boarding Naval Doctrine.
Dude, Where's my Boat?.completion: Capture 20 boats Have the Boarding naval doctrine

Early-Modern Warfare.notes: Easy as Ming ; just go slightly over force limit and drill for ten years.

Electable!.description: Become an elector in the HRE as a country which does not start as elector.
Electable!.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Become an elector of the Holy Roman Empire
Electable!.notes: Most easily done as Austria via the Usurp the Electorate decision after taking Bohemia as a junior partner. Other HRE members can request the electorate either with money or by being allied to and having excellent relations with the Emperor. Another possibility is to inherit (not integrate!) an elector (e.g. as Austria or Hungary , who can both get a personal union over Bohemia ) at which point the electorate will pass to the inheriting partner.

Forgive me, for I have Sindh.completion: Is Sindh Religion is in Christian group
Forgive me, for I have Sindh.notes: The island Suqutra is the nearest Christian province and can be easily conquered from its owner Mahra , who will normally ally your neighbor Baluchistan Sell your province Umarkot to a neighboring country (since Baluchistan does not want it) and declare war on them with your reconquest casus belli. Then, head to Mahra to eliminate their armies and siege their provinces until they will accept giving you Suqutra in a separate peace deal (you do not need to land any troops on the island for it to be selectable). Next, give Baluchistan all of your mainland provinces in a peace deal and declare bankruptcy. Since you are an OPM on a Coptic province, this will convert you to Coptic and grant the achievement.

Four For Trade.description: Form four Trade Companies and get bonus merchants from all of them.
Four For Trade.notes: A trade company must control at least 51% of the provincial trade power in its node for it to be a "strong" company and give you an extra merchant. Far easier since 1.30, as trade companies can now be made in all regions not your own that aren't colonial regions, including European regions.

God Tier.description: Become a Tier 5 Defender of the Faith as a nation that is neither Catholic nor Sunni.
God Tier.completion: Religion is not Catholic or Sunni Is defender of the faith of tier 5
God Tier.notes: Easiest to do as a HRE member state such as Holland. Convert to Protestantism as soon as possible. The amount of HRE minors who will convert should minimise the amount of player involvement. If necessary, declare war on smaller European nations and use the "Force Religion" option in the peace deal. Colonial nations also contribute to the rank of Defender of the Faith. The achievement is hidden without the Emperor DLC, but it is possible to get the achievement without the DLC, by having 50+ nations following the faith you are defender of.

Grand Coalition.description: Join a coalition of more than 5 nations.
Grand Coalition.completion: Be a part of a coalition with 6 or more members
Grand Coalition.notes: Most easily achieved as Ming by cancelling the tributary status of whichever Southeast Asian state has been expanding the most. You still get the achievement for joining after the war has started, since you'll need to wait for the truce to expire.

Grand Duchy.description: Starting as a Duchy, have 1000 development without upgrading your government rank.
Grand Duchy.completion: Government rank is Duchy Has at least 1000 development
Grand Duchy.notes: Muscovy is the largest duchy in 1444, though Lithuania could also work well. The most important thing is to remember not to upgrade or form a nation (like Russia or Commonwealth ) that gives a higher government rank as you'll become ineligible for the achievement. Another way to do this is to start as a duchy in the HRE. You can become the Emperor and still be eligible for the achievement. You just need to lose the emperorship, which returns you to duchy rank. This method allows you to expand with the governing capacity of an empire, which makes this achievement trivial.

Hard Bargaining.description: As Defender of a Muslim Faith, propagate your religion in The Moluccas through trade to convert 5 provinces.
Hard Bargaining.completion: Is in the Muslim religious group Is Defender of the Faith Propagated Religion in 5 provinces in the Moluccas trade node
Hard Bargaining.notes: You are required to be Defender of the Faith when the conversion of each province finishes.

Holiest Roman Empire.description: As either the Papal States or the Emperor, have the Papal States as an Elector while the HRE is officially Catholic.
Holiest Roman Empire.completion: Is The Papal State or is the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire Catholic is the dominant faith of the Holy Roman Empire The Holy Roman Empire has an official, unchangeable faith The Papal State is an elector
Holiest Roman Empire.notes: You can start as Austria , and full annex The Papal State When The Papal State is given a province in the empire, you can grant them elector status. Note that passing the Proclaim Erbkaisertum reform before Catholicism is the official faith of the HRE will enact the Peace of Westphalia, preventing this achievement.

Imperio español.description: As Spain have Mexico, Panama, Havana, Cuzco in colonial Nations under you.
Imperio español.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Spain Have colonial nations in Mexico, Panama, Havana, and Cuzco. Expand

In the Name of the Father.description: As an Orthodox country, have 100 Patriarch Authority.
In the Name of the Father.notes: Constantinople and Kiev have monuments which give yearly patriarch authority

It's all about luck.description: Win a battle against a great leader, without a leader.
It's all about luck.completion: Defeated an enemy leader with 3 stars.
It's all about luck.notes: Easily done as the Ottomans attacking Albania at the start of the campaign.

Just Resting In My Account.description: Corrupt the officials in a Rival country.
Just Resting In My Account.completion: Used the covert action Corrupt Officials against a rival country.

Kow-Tow.description: As Ming, have a subject from each religion group.
Kow-Tow.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Have a subject nation in the 5 religious groups Christian, Muslim, Eastern, Dharmic and Pagan
Kow-Tow.notes: The Jewish and Zoroastrian groups are not needed. No CB War against Mikhlaf in Arabia, vassalize them in the peace deal. Ally a neighbour (Yemen or Hormuz can be a good choice), ask for maps of the horn of Africa and then establish one of the Coptic minors as a tributary or vassal. Medri Bahri can be a good choice. Proclaim a Guarantee to protect them while you improve relations.

Land of Eastern Jade.description: Own a core province in the Mexico region as a Buddhist country.
Land of Eastern Jade.completion: Be Theravada, Vajrayana, or Mahayana. Own a core province in the region Mexico
Land of Eastern Jade.notes: An interesting choice is Ayutthaya. Start by choosing exploration ideas, colonize the islands in Indonesia, followed by the Marshall Islands, and Midway. Then focus on North America, and most likely you can colonize Sinaloa, which is the easiest path for this achievement.

Let It Go!.description: Starting as Norway, have your capital in the Canada region while not owning any province in Scandinavia and not playing as a released subject.
Let It Go!.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Capital is in the Canada region Owns no province in the Scandinavia region
Let It Go!.notes: Forming countries is allowed, but playing as a released colonial nation or switching to a different country is not allowed. The easiest way to be rid of provinces in Europe is to release Sápmi and Iceland as subjects, giving them all other provinces in Europe other than your capital. At that point, moving your capital into America is allowed, and then giving away the last European province should complete the achievement.

Made in Japan.completion: The year is before 1655 Is Japan Has embraced the Manufactories institution
Made in Japan.notes: Colonize the west coast of America as soon as possible to gain Colonialism. Do not enforce Sakoku when the option presents itself, since that will make it harder to get Global Trade.

Magellan’s Voyage.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is the first to circumnavigate the World.
Magellan’s Voyage.notes: Colonize along the route as much as possible, or get fleet basing rights. Fully-repaired ships can be stationed along the way to join the explorer's fleet before he moves to the next sea tile. If the fleet stops to repair, ships can also be sent to augment it while it is in port. How long the AI takes to circumnavigate varies from game to game.

Maharana Pratap.description: Start as Mewar and field an army of 20 Rajput regiments.
Maharana Pratap.notes: See Rajput regiment and Special unit force limit for ways to get more Rajput regiments. Forming another country such as Rajputana does not prevent the achievement, but the formed country will still need to have access to the Rajputs estate.

Multiculturalism.description: Have 4 different Cultures and 4 different religions represented in your court.
Multiculturalism.completion: Four different religions in court Four different cultures in court
Multiculturalism.notes: Spawned advisors take the culture and religion of a random held province. Easy as Ming : dismiss advisors until you have one Theravada, one Animist, and one Vajrayana advisor. Release nations to increase the proportion of your provinces which have one of the remaining religions.

My True Friend.description: Go to war in support of a rebel faction and win, enforcing their demands.
My True Friend.completion: Help a rebel faction win a war against another country
My True Friend.notes: Can be completed at the same time as the Viva la Revolución! achievement.

Networking.description: Have 100 point spy networks in 3 Rival nations.
Networking.completion: Have 100 point spy networks in 3 rival nations
Networking.notes: Hard to get with Mare Nostrum enabled since AI will use counter-espionage against rivals. A slow but easy method involves starting as a nation with at least 3 diplomats, building the spy networks in your rival nations and waiting until you get the achievement or annexed.

Nobody wants to die.completion: Own and core the province of Timbuktu
Nobody wants to die.notes: Can be done swiftly by declaring a no- casus belli war a month from the start of the game, before any alliances are made. Hiring a handful of mercenaries will help with the conquest, whereas hiring an administrative advisor and changing the national focus to administrative will help to core the province sooner.

On the Edge of Madness.description: As Aztecs, reach 95 Doom, then go 20 years without Doom hitting 100.
On the Edge of Madness.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Reach 95 Doom, then survive for 20 years without hitting 100 Doom. Had the flag doom_reached_95 for 20 years and do not have flag doom_reached_100
On the Edge of Madness.notes: It is not required to keep doom between 95 and 100 for 20 years, but make sure you are at 95 doom at least once when a month tick happens so the countdown actually starts. Doom may drop below 95 at any time. Passing religious reforms (except the Reform Religion button, which disables doom) will also not prevent the achievement. Changing religion (e.g. to mayan or animist) after hitting 95 doom will also not prevent the achievement.

One Family to Rule them All.description: Have your dynasty on 8 thrones at the same time. Client states do not count.
One Family to Rule them All.completion: Is monarchy Is not in a regency Have the same dynasty as 8 other non-client state nations
One Family to Rule them All.notes: Can be easily done as Ming Release 8 nations as vassals (make sure you pick nations that will have an eastern religion) and use the Place Relative on Throne Subject interaction

One King to Rule!.description: As Poland, become an absolutist monarchy, abolishing the Sejm.
One King to Rule!.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is a monarchy Have 50 absolutism Has not enacted one of the following government reforms: ‘ Elective Monarchy ’ ‘ Great Sejm ’ ‘ Polish Elective Monarchy ’

One Night in Paris.description: Start as England, own and have a core on Paris (do not form another country unless it's Great Britain or the Angevin Kingdom).
One Night in Paris.completion: Is England , Great Britain , or the Angevin Kingdom Own and core Paris

Pirate Bay of Janjira.description: Have more than 50% Privateering power in the Gujarat trade node
Pirate Bay of Janjira.completion: Has at least 50% trade power from privateers in the Gujarat trade node

Purify the Temple.description: Starting as Riga, enact the Salvific Plutocracy government reform and raid the heretic church of Rome.
Purify the Temple.completion: Has enacted the Salvific Plutocracy government reform Raided the province Roma (118) with the peace term “Raid Heretic Churches”
Purify the Temple.notes: “Raid Heretic Churches” always selects Roma (118) as long as it has a Church or Cathedral. You need to convert to another Christian religion to enact Salvific Plutocracy “Raid Heretic Churches” can also be chosen for secondary war participants.

Queen of Mercury.description: As Kilwa, own and have cores on Zanzibar and Bombay (Thana).
Queen of Mercury.completion: Is Kilwa Own and core Zanzibar and Thana.
Queen of Mercury.notes: Since Kilwa starts with Zanzibar, essentially the goal is to expand to Thana on the west coast of India which is owned by Gujarat at the start of the game. If you form any nation, you will be ineligible for the achievement. Much easier with the Dharma expansion, as you can simply charter Thana off its owner.

Relentless Push East.description: Starting as a Russian nation, By 1600 own the East Siberian Coastline.
Relentless Push East.completion: Year is before 1601 Own all port provinces in the East Siberia region Expand These provinces are Kamchatka, Penzhina, Kagyrgyn, Gizhiga, Tauisk, Okhotsk and Jugjur.
Relentless Push East.notes: Note that it is not necessary to core the provinces. Even unfinished colonies count. This achievement is pretty easy to reach as Muscovy and you can finish it 40 to 50 years before the deadline. It is recommended to form Russia and take advantage of their Siberian Frontier idea, helping idea groups like exploration and expansion will then be optional. But a colonist from these groups can be used to start colonies if the time runs out and one of the Siberian ports has already been cored or fully colonized.

Respected.description: Have 100 prestige, 100 legitimacy and three stability.
Respected.completion: Have 100 prestige Have 100 legitimacy Have +3 stability
Respected.notes: Fight battles and explore terra incognita to increase prestige. Maintain positive stability, have heirs with strong claim and control the amount of royal marriages to increase legitimacy. Wait for stability improving events and invest administrative points to increase stability. Easy to achieve as Russia The decision “ Make St. Petersburg the Capital ” gives the player 100 prestige, which fulfills the most difficult requirement if the player had non-negative prestige. Having a level 3 advisor or higher will eventually cause an event to trigger that will let the player choose to gain 50 prestige.

Royal Authority.description: Install a union through a succession war.
Royal Authority.completion: Have installed a union in a succession war.
Royal Authority.notes: Win a war with the "Claim on Throne" or "Restore Union" casus belli The former is used in succession wars. Only requires winning a war with the right CB; the peace deal does not actually need to force a union. Easily done as Muscovy against Ryazan , or against Tver with a claim on throne.

Rozwi Empire.description: Starting as Butua, conquer Mutapa (Zimbabwe and Lower Zambezi areas).
Rozwi Empire.completion: Own all provinces in the following areas: Butua Lower Zambezi Zimbabwe Expand
Rozwi Empire.notes: Easy only with Conquest of Paradise or El Dorado DLC. Starting in 1444 you can always get Kilwa (and at least one of these: Tumbuka, Maravi, Makua) to support your independence. Declare war ASAP and boost your gold production. Without either of these DLCs, you're on your own. Save up money and build an army when Mutapa has started integrating you.

Shemot is Not.description: As a Jewish nation, convert all of Egypt to Jewish while having the Jewish Community Aspect active.
Shemot is Not.completion: Religion is Jewish The church aspect “ Jewish Community ” is active All provinces in the Egypt region are Jewish Expand
Shemot is Not.notes: Easiest to do as Mamluks Conquer Semien (and Dembiya) in Ethiopia and immediately send a missionary with 0 maintenance to switch the rebels to Jewish Zealots (before the previous rebel type in the province has reached 30% progress). Let the rebels spawn and let them convert the country. Once Jewish has become the dominant religion , the rebel demands will also include to change the state religion. Then the demands can be accepted, but it might be beneficial to let them convert more provinces. After becoming Jewish, finish converting Egypt and choose Jewish Community as your first aspect.

Sikh Pun.description: Convert to Sikhism and form the nation of Punjab.
Sikh Pun.notes: Aside from forming Punjab, releasing Punjab as a vassal and playing it and converting to Sikh is also possible.

Strait Talk.description: As Hormuz, have at least 10 diplomatic reputation
Strait Talk.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Hormuz Has at least 10 diplomatic reputation
Strait Talk.notes: Diplomatic reputation is gained from Hormuz ideas and completing missions. Easier since 1.24 since one of Islam's taxation policies gives +1 Diplomatic reputation.

Surfing USA.start: Playing as Hawai'i , Maui , O'ahu or Kaua'i
Surfing USA.notes: It is advised to not colonise the nearby islands in your region. To form USA you need to move your capital to the Colonial Eastern America region, and to be able to do that you will need to move your capital. This can be done if it's the only province in a state, i,e, Hawaii. Consider releasing vassals in your home islands to achieve this. It is best to use neigbor islands to grind power projection and monarch points for spawning institutions. O'ahu and Maui are better candidates, because both border 2 islands. The only way to get North America in colonial range by 1480 is by taking Exploration idea group and Polynesian_Navigation naval doctrine.

Sweet Home Qaraqorum.description: As the Mughals assimilate Mongolian culture.
Sweet Home Qaraqorum.completion: Is Mughals Has the Mughal Diwan government reform Have Mongol as accepted culture
Sweet Home Qaraqorum.notes: Easiest by starting as the Timurids Forming the Mughals should not be a problem as long as you keep your vassals loyal and conquer Delhi. After that you should carve your way up to the Mongolian culture area. Fabricate claims along the way and conquer the provinces needed to reach that area. Usually you can start by declaring war on Uzbek, followed by Oirat. The factions controlling those provinces differ from campaign to campaign. In order to assimilate you need to conquer ALL Mongolian culture provinces. With the Winds of Change DLC mission tree, staying as Timurids is advise to use their bonuses and permanent claim on the mongol region.

The Coin is Stronger than the Sword.description: Charter Company from an Indian nation.
The Coin is Stronger than the Sword.completion: Has successfully used the Charter Trade Company diplomatic interaction to buy a province in India.
The Coin is Stronger than the Sword.notes: Chartering a province from outside India proper will not grant the achievement (e.g. buying the Maldives from Vijayanagar ), but chartering a province in India from a country which has it's capital somewhere else works.

The Emperors new clothes.description: Overthrow Austria and become the Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire.
The Emperors new clothes.completion: Is emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
The Emperors new clothes.notes: Become emperor of the Holy Roman Empire. Austrian players already start as the emperor so they won't get the achievement. Easiest to do as Bohemia.

The Power of Three.description: Own a Crown Colony, a Self-Governing Colony and a Private Enterprise.
The Power of Three.completion: Has a Crown Colony Has a Self-Governing Colony Has a Private Enterprise

The Princess is in this Castle.description: As a country that does not start with a female heir, have a female heir while having a Castle in your capital (more advanced fort buildings do not count).
The Princess is in this Castle.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Capital has Castle Have a female heir
The Princess is in this Castle.notes: Easily done as Castile by waiting for the Iberian wedding event while not upgrading or deleting the capital fort. Note that most Muslim countries cannot get female heirs, and those that can have a very low probability of getting one.

The Spice Must Flow.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Malaya

The White Company.description: Join a war on the other side of someone to whom you have rented condottieri.
The White Company.completion: Join a war against a nation that you hire out condottieri to. Have the country flag white_company
The White Company.notes: As you don't have to accept a call to arms for a few months the easiest way to do this is when one of your allies asks you to join a war, first rent out condottieri to one of their enemies in the war then accept the call to arms.

To the Bone.description: As Bone, use pillage capital at least 7 times.
To the Bone.completion: Is Bone Has used the pillage capital peace term at least 7 times

Trade Hegemon.description: Starting as any European country, conquer and have cores on Aden, Hormoz and Malacca.
Trade Hegemon.completion: Own and core the provinces of Aden, Hormuz and Malacca Expand
Trade Hegemon.notes: Note that nations such as Ottomans , Kazan and Great Horde are considered as European countries.

Turn the Table.description: As a colony, break free and vassalize your former overlord without forming any other nation.
Turn the Table.completion: Playing as a former colonial nation Vassalize the former owner of the colonial nation
Turn the Table.notes: Forming another country as the colonial nation will prevent this achievement even if that country is a colonial formable like USA or Australia Easily done as Ternate Colonize Australia to the point where a colonial nation forms. Release them and select 'Play As', then vassalize your former overlord.

Turning the Tide.description: Start as a Steppe Horde in 1444 and embrace all institutions.
Turning the Tide.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Have embraced all institutions
Turning the Tide.notes: Much faster in pre-1.17 patches, where the requirement is westernizing, which can be done by around 1520 instead of waiting until 1750 for the institutions to appear.

Vasa or Wettin?.description: Get a ruler of your dynasty on the throne of Poland or the Commonwealth while they are an elective monarchy.
Vasa or Wettin?.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Poland or the Commonwealth has a ruler that is of your dynasty and was acquired via the elective monarchy.
Vasa or Wettin?.notes: Once Poland enables elective monarchy countries of the same religion can support candidates to their throne via diplomatic action. High diplomatic reputation and good relations with Poland increase the likelihood gaining support. If Poland chooses a local noble instead of the PU with Lithuania it won't get an elective monarchy, making this achievement impossible.

Viva la Revolución!.description: Have rebels you support in another country enforce their demands.
Viva la Revolución!.completion: Have supported rebels in another country that enforced their demands.
Viva la Revolución!.notes: Possible to do as Tondo , as neighbouring Pangasinan starts with a single province of a heathen religion. Immediately rival them and declare an offensive war using the Humiliate Rival CB. Sit on their capital to increase their war exhaustion until you can support the Animist rebels. When an uprising is about to take place, white peace. The rebels will enforce their demands as soon as they take the province.

Voting Streak.description: Successfully pass 11 issues in a row in Parliament.
Voting Streak.completion: Pass 11 parliament issues in a row
Voting Streak.notes: England , Navarra , Poland , and Scotland start with a parliament in 1444.

Where Am I?.description: As a New World native with Random New World active, explore the entire New World.
Where Am I?.completion: Has discovered all provinces in the New World.
Where Am I?.notes: Eligible countries show “Tribe” as the government in the nation selection screen or are custom nations with one of the government reforms in the “Native” category Sometimes a random world is generated where all of the land is already discovered by most native nations, one only needs to unpause in order to get the achievement

Winged Hussars.description: Have Winged Hussars as your active unit with more than +50% cavalry combat ability.
Winged Hussars.completion: Have Winged Hussars as your primary cavalry unit Have a cavalry combat ability of at least 50%
Winged Hussars.notes: Winged Hussars cavalry unit is part of the Eastern technology group (military tech level 22). This is not the same as the Winged Hussars special unit For details on cavalry combat ability see the article on Land units Poland is the easiest nation to play for this achievement due to the cavalry combat ability in their national ideas. Taking Aristocratic and Quality ideas will give Poland enough combat ability to satisfy this achievement.

World Discoverer.notes: You do not have to discover all Terra Incognita yourself, as TI can be automatically uncovered via spread of discovery. The condition is simply that no TI exists in the world for you, not including sea zones. Wastelands are not needed. Easiest in Europe. With Mare Nostrum DLC, a good way to find the last few is to check the Request to share maps diplomatic action on colonizers or anybody else.

You Get A New Home, And You Get A New Ho.description: Expel 5 different minorities to your colonies.
You Get A New Home, And You Get A New Ho.completion: Has expelled 5 different minorities to colonial provinces.

A Fine Goosestep.description: Form Prussia and have at least 125% Discipline.
A Fine Goosestep.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Prussia Have 125% discipline
A Fine Goosestep.notes: The following actions can increase Prussian discipline: Expand Increasing Militarization of Country (maximum +10% ) Increasing Absolutism (maximum +5% ) Completing Quality Ideas ( +5% ) Unlocking “Esprit de Corps” in Offensive ideas ( +5% ) Economic-Quality policy “Weapon Quality Standards” ( +5% ) Unlocking the Prussian ambition ( +5% ) Having a Commandant advisor ( +5% ) Having a ruler with the “Strict” personality ( +5% ) Converting to Protestantism and obtaining the Aspect of Faith “Holy Sacraments” ( +2.5% )

A tale of two Families.description: Starting as Vijayanagar or Bahmanis conquer the other’s capital and have them not exist.
A tale of two Families.completion: Own and core the provinces Bidar (1948) and Vijayanagar (541) Is either : Bahmanis and Vijayanagar doesn't exist Vijayanagar and Bahmanis doesn't exist

AEIOU.completion: Complete one of the following mission trees: Austrian missions from the Emperor DLC Austrian missions from the Winds of Change DLC
AEIOU.notes: You can trigger the religious peace by enacting "Proclaim Erbkaisertum" reform, since it will not block the mission A Holy Empire Forming another country which gives new missions (e.g. Germany or unifying the Holy Roman Empire ) will prevent you from getting the achievement.

All Your Trade Are Belong to Us.description: Have the highest trade power in Genoa, Venice and English Channel while having an income of at least 300 ducats per month.
All Your Trade Are Belong to Us.completion: Highest Trade power in Genoa, Venice, and English Channel Have 300 income
All Your Trade Are Belong to Us.notes: Easily done as England or Netherlands by controlling the English Channel via provincial trade power and sending light ships to the Venice and Genoa trade nodes.

Arabian Coffee.description: Form Arabia and be the nation producing the most coffee in the world.
Arabian Coffee.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Arabia Be production leader of coffee
Arabian Coffee.notes: Coffee is common in the area around Ethiopia and Mali If you are not the leading producer after conquering these areas, build manufactories or conquer Mesoamerica. Forming Arabia is easiest as The Mamluks

Atwix Legacy.description: Have 10 personal unions at the same time.
Atwix Legacy.notes: A good way is to choose a country with many PUs in its mission tree such as Hungary, Bohemia or Austria. Follow Atwix guide and make use of the new favor feature to spread your dynasty. Ensure that your PU subjects are fairly large to avoid inheriting their throne.

Barbarossa.description: As a Maghrebi nation, have 500 light ships privateering at the same time.

Bengal Tiger.description: Start as Bengal and own Samarkand as a core province.

Bleed Them Dry.description: Have 10 different War Reparations being paid to you at the same time.
Bleed Them Dry.completion: Have 10 War Reparations at the same time
Bleed Them Dry.notes: Can be done more easily as Austria or current Holy Roman Emperor.

Breaking the Yoke.description: As Ryazan, own Saratov, Crimea and Kazan while being independent.
Breaking the Yoke.completion: Is not a subject nation Own the provinces of Crimea (284), Kazan (1082) and Saratov (303) Expand

Carthago Delenda Est.description: As an Italian culture nation, make sure entire Tunis Area is at 100 devastation.
Carthago Delenda Est.completion: Culture group is Latin All provinces in the Tunisia area have 100 devastation
Carthago Delenda Est.notes: Culture must be Latin at game start and when Tunisia is devastated. Naples is by far the strongest and closest Latin nation in 1444. Regardless of the nation selected, declare a war in which land may be taken from Tunis. Take the Tunisia area in the war. Then go bankrupt repeatedly until you have 100 devastation (going bankrupt adds 10 devastation to all provinces). The first bankruptcy can be declared manually, but this button can't be used while being bankrupt. So the subsequent bankruptcies must be achieved by taking the maximum amount of loans and spending all the money while running a deficit. A high deficit can be achieved by using the loans to hire and upgrade advisors. This is far faster than trying to raise devastation using other methods such as occupying the land while at war and using scorch earth.

Cherrypicking.description: Conscript a 3 star general from a Daimyo Subject.
Cherrypicking.completion: Conscript a 3-star general from a Daimyo subject
Cherrypicking.notes: The most reliable way is to vassalize a Jurchen tribe and make them fulfill their mission Unite the Jurchen Tribes (the Domination DLC must be deactivated ) which gives a 3-star general as a reward. This can be done in under a month by creating a custom nation shogun, releasing a Jurchen subject and feeding them the required provinces. Another way to get a subject with a 3-star general would be to vassalize Ayutthaya and help them complete the mission Embassy to Japan But this requires that they have not completed the mission already.

Core-fu.description: Force a nation to revoke 5 cores in one peace deal as Corfu.
Core-fu.completion: Is Corfu Forced a country to revoke 5 cores in one peace deal
Core-fu.notes: Although this achievement can theoretically be started as any nation due to Corfu being a releasable nation, the cores need to be revoked while you are Corfu. Forcing a nation to revoke cores as another nation, then releasing Corfu will not count.

Dar al-Islam.completion: Is in the Muslim religious group Has country modifier A United Islam Expand Enact the "Unify Islam" decision. Requires the following provinces:
Dar al-Islam.notes: Requires Star and Crescent DLC. Easiest to do as Ottomans

Definitely the Sultan of Rum.description: Own and have cores on Rome, Moscow and Istanbul as Ottomans or Rum.
Definitely the Sultan of Rum.completion: Is Ottomans or Rûm Own and core Moskva, Constantinople, and Roma. Expand
Definitely the Sultan of Rum.notes: Make sure to attack Muscovy ASAP to remove a future potential threat.

Don’t be Cilli.description: Starting as Cilli, form another nation.
Don’t be Cilli.completion: is not Cilli Not playing as a released vassal
Don’t be Cilli.notes: Can be done by annexing Croatia , then culture shifting and re-forming it. Use the fact that you are eligible to form a royal marriage with both Austria and Hungary in the early game and later grab alliances with Poland and/or Bohemia to defeat Hungary for the important provinces.

Even Better than Piet Heyn.description: Gain over 100 gold from privateering a single treasure fleet.
Even Better than Piet Heyn.completion: Gained over 100 gold by plundering a treasure fleet.

Fine Financials.description: Own Eight level 3 Centres of Trade.
Fine Financials.completion: Own 8 provinces that have a level 3 center of trade.
Fine Financials.notes: The maximum number of level 3 centers of trade equals the number of merchants you have. It should be easy to get more merchants with trade companies.

For Odin!.description: Starting as a Norse custom nation with no more than 200 points and a maximum of 5 provinces, own & core Scandinavia and the British Isles and convert it all to Norse.
For Odin!.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Religion is Norse Own and core all provinces in Britain and Scandinavia All provinces in Britain and Scandinavia have Norse religion. Expand Britain and Scandinavia
For Odin!.notes: Can also be paired with From Humble Origins and Ideas Guy

Fugger Banking.description: As Augsburg, subsidize 3 Great Powers 20% of their income while having less than 20 provinces.
Fugger Banking.completion: Is Augsburg less than 20 provinces Subsidize 3 Great Powers at least 20% of their income.
Fugger Banking.notes: The subsidies also count as income, so the subsidies have to be 25% of the income before subsidies. The total income can be seen in the Income Comparison page in the ledger. The Country page doesn't show all income sources. You can subsidize up to 50% of your income to each country, which means you need to reach at least half the income of the 3 poorest great powers. A good way to get it quickly is to get a hold of the Inntal or Eger goldmine and to develop it.

Ganges Khan.description: Start as Tribal nation in India and become a Steppe Horde.
Ganges Khan.completion: Has the Steppe Nomads government reform
Ganges Khan.notes: This achievement is only visible if the Dharma or Emperor DLC is enabled, but it can be completed without them. Eligible countries are: Expand Bastar Bishnupur Chanda Garha Garjat Jangladesh Jeypore Jhalavad Jharkhand Junagarh Kachar Kalahandi Keonhjar Kutch Ladakh Manipur Patna Parlakhimidi Porbandar Ratanpur Sadiya Tripura

Georgia on my Mind.completion: Own or have a non-tributary subject own all provinces in the areas: Kartli-Kakheti , Samtskhe and Imereti Own or have a non-tributary subject own all provinces in the areas: Georgia and Upper Georgia Own or have a non-tributary subject own the province of South Georgia (2025) Expand
Georgia on my Mind.notes: Easiest to do as a coloniser such as France , Spain or Great Britain since you can easily acquire the required provinces in North America and the South Atlantic. Remaining provinces can be obtained by declaring no-CB wars on nations in Caucasia to vassalize them early before they're conquered by Russia or the Ottomans

Gold Rush.completion: The year is before 1500 Is Golden Horde

Golden Horn.description: As a Somali nation, fully own the Horn of Africa region and have a monthly gold income of at least 10 ducats.
Golden Horn.completion: All provinces of the Horn of Africa region are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects Have 10 income from gold Expand
Golden Horn.notes: Note that the provinces of Fazughli, Afder and Ogaden have to be colonized for the achievement, but the colonies do not need to be complete. You can just send your colonist to all 3 provinces at once as soon as you have the other land. Start as Adal or Ajuuraan , and set the National Focus to administrative, then swiftly conquer all adjacent nations in the region that are smaller than you. Aggressive Expansion will not be an issue due to the nations belonging to different religious groups. To attain the gold income, improve production development in the gold provinces Kaffa (2757) and Damot (2762). Convert the religion in the gold provinces to your state religion, which will increase your gold income, requiring less development.

Golden Wind.description: As Air, make 50 ducats profit per month and have 50% of your income made through gold provinces.
Golden Wind.completion: Is Air monthly balance is at least 50 50% of the monthly income is from gold
Golden Wind.notes: This achievement is only visible if the Origins DLC is active, but no DLC is needed to complete it. As Air consider royal marrying Songhai and Mali and improving relations after to get an alliance. Both should start neutral most of the time and are strong allies. After, look for choice targets and build over force limit by hiring a free company. Air starts with a level 2 fort on their capital so rushing smaller enemy capital forts is a viable strategy, no need to take unnecessary battles. You need 50 positive balance, not income. Consider disbanding armies, firing advisors and deleting forts when your income is over 60 ducats, with at least 50% gold income. Almost all expenses can be reduced to near 0 except for state maintenance. To get enough gold income controlling and developing the three gold mines in West Africa should be enough. In 1444 two are owned by Mali and one by Kong

Great Moravia.description: Restore the Great Moravian borders as Nitra or Moravia.
Great Moravia.completion: Is Nitra , Moravia or Great Moravia Own and core the following provinces: Expand
Great Moravia.notes: Nitra's cores don't expire except by culture conversion. Requires all the territory of Bohemia , Glogow and Opole , Wien (134), Manhartsberg (1770), Traungau (4761) and Wienerwald (4762) from Austria , Kraków (262) and Nowy Sącz (2960) from Poland , and the Slovakia and Transdanubia areas from Hungary If choosing to play as Moravia , you will incur much more agresssive expansion and find it harder to make alliances due to being a heretic nation (Hussite) if you release them on day 1. There are advantages to starting in the empire though, so you may find it useful to convert some of Moravia's cores to Catholic before switching to them. Since this achievement demands the release of a nation it doesn't have the "started as" protection. In return the easiest way to achieve this is to play Hungary or Austria, get all the lands, release Nitra and grant it all provinces. Reabsorb it once possible and release to play as. The deed will be done. This works for any of the create or release achievements and turns these deeds trivial. Since Winds of change, this achievement is doable simply by forming Greater Moravia, which can be done by Bohemia.

Hanukkah Mutapa.description: Starting as Mutapa, convert to Judaism and celebrate a festival.
Hanukkah Mutapa.completion: Religion is Jewish Has used the Jewish religion action “Celebrate Festival”
Hanukkah Mutapa.notes: This achievement is misspelled as “Hannukah Mutapa” in the steam version of the game. At the start of the game the 2 only Jewish provinces are in Ethiopia , due to Ethiopia 's missions the AI will always pick the option to temporarily accept Jewish religion, giving you 25 years to take them. Mutapa 's gold mines should allow you to go over force limit and quickly declare a war of conquest against Kilwa despite the technology disadvantage. With additional 3 gold mines in Butua after annexing vassal Butua and conquering Sofala and Kilwa even more mercenaries over force limit can be paid. Focus on military mana to not fall further behind Ethiopia and nations lying in the way to the jewish provinces.

Hessian Mercenaries.description: As Hesse, have at least 50 regiments of mercenaries and no loans.
Hessian Mercenaries.completion: Not playing as a released vassal is Hesse Have 50 regiments of mercenaries Have no loans

Hoarder.description: As a Fetishist nation, have 13 available Cults.
Hoarder.completion: Is Fetishist Have unlocked 13 Fetishist cults
Hoarder.notes: With the Cradle of Civilization DLC activated, Kilwa may convert all of Madagascar to Islam once they gain more than 50% trade power in Zanzibar, making the achievement impossible if the three Malagasy cults have not been gained already.

Home and Away.description: As Wales, hold Cardiff, Dublin, Edinburgh, Rome, Paris and London.
Home and Away.completion: Is Wales Own Glamorgan (241), Pale (373), Lothian (248), Roma (118), Paris (183) and London (236)
Home and Away.notes: It is not needed to core the required provinces. The welsh names of the provinces in eu4 are Morgannwg(241), Dulyn(373), Lleuddiniawn(248), Rhufain(118), Paris(183) and Llundain(236)

Ideas Guy.description: Starting as a custom nation with the full 800 points but no more than 3 total development, have a monthly income of at least 500 ducats.
Ideas Guy.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Has at least 500 ducats in income
Ideas Guy.notes: Despite the description, can be done with fewer than 800 points. Spoils of war do not count towards the income; you must make 500 ducats, not including Spoils. It became very easy after Third Rome, due to Siberian frontier ability: Start a nation in Americas with Siberian Frontier as a tradition, it will allow you to expand in uncolonized regions rapidly. One way to cheese this achievement post-1.36 is to take the provinces of Iskandariyya, Rashid, Dumyat, and Sharqiya, as well as war reparations from the Mamluks Build Marketplaces in Iskandariyya, Rashid, and Dumyat, and 5 buildings in Sharqiya, as well as ensuring that Sharqiya has been developed 10 times, and then return all provinces. This allows the Mamluks to complete the mission "Highway of an Empire", which temporarily grants them 20,000 ducats, which you get 2,000 from via war reparations. Make sure the Mamluks are able to pay for the construction of the canal, with inflation taken into consideration by gifting money to them before they complete the mission by checking the ledger. For example, if the ledger says the Mamluks have 1% inflation, round that up to 2% and multiply by 20,000 ducats; thus, ensure the Mamluks have 400 ducats in their treasury. On the next month tick, you will receive 2,000 ducats in income. The 3-development province of Tarrana provides the perfect starting position and you can easily load up on military ideas for your traditions like +1 Infantry Shock and +1 Cavalry Shock which are insanely overpowered in the beginning of the game. Can also be paired with For Odin! and From Humble Origins

Industrial Powerhouse.description: Have 10 furnaces built in your nation.

Italian Ambition.notes: Become Italy The primary culture of the country you start with should be in the Latin culture group (the achievement won't be visible in game unless you are Latin) but you can also get the achievement via culture shift. The Papal State and The Holy Roman Empire can't form Italy.

Je maintiendrai.description: Form the Netherlands as a minor nation starting with Dutch culture.
Je maintiendrai.notes: Possible starts are Holland , Utrecht , Gelre Easily done as Holland by seeking independence support from Burgundy 's enemies and then carefully eating the other Dutch minors. One could also try grabbing the Burgundian inheritance as Gelre, which grants most of the land required for free.

Kingdom of God.description: Starting as the Papal State, become the Kingdom of God
Kingdom of God.completion: Has enacted the decision Declare the Kingdom of God

Kirishitan Japan.description: Start as a Japanese Daimyo, convert yourself and all of Japan to Christianity.
Kirishitan Japan.completion: Is Japan In Christian religious group All provinces in Japanese region are in Christian religious group.
Kirishitan Japan.notes: You must start as a Daimyo subject of Ashikaga The Japan region includes Okinawa, Hokkaido, and the Kuril Islands. Uncolonized provinces are required as well. Best done with Otomo , who receive an extra missionary in addition to increased papal influence. Wait for the Spread of Christianity incident, which usually pops up around 1600 or so. Always take the most "Open" or pro-Christian options in events. A few years after the incident ends, an event to convert to Catholic will pop up. If Mandate of Heaven is disabled: don't take the decision to enforce Sakoku, wait for events to convert your provinces and spawn Catholic rebels, and let them convert at least half your provinces. Harder if you have too many disconnected provinces outside the Japan region.

Kuban Cigars.description: As Kuba, own or have a subject own Havana and be the world’s leading producer of Tobacco.
Kuban Cigars.completion: Own or have a non-tributary subject own the province Havana (484) The leading producer of Tobacco is either this country or a subject of this country
Kuban Cigars.notes: Not possible with Random New World. Making the leading tobacco producer a tributary would count.

Kushite Restoration.description: As a Nubian culture nation, own or have a non-Tributary subject own the entire Egyptian region.
Kushite Restoration.completion: All provinces in the Egypt region are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects
Kushite Restoration.notes: Possible starts are Dongola , Alodia , and Makuria

Laughingstock.description: Own the provinces of Haha, Hehe and Lolland.
Laughingstock.completion: Own the provinces of Lolland (1983), Haha (2470), and Hehe (4073) Expand
Laughingstock.notes: Lolland begins held by Denmark , Haha held by Morocco , and Hehe uncolonized in Central Africa. Easiest to No CB Morocco before Iberians take Haha, then push through Kongo with expansion ideas to reach Hehe which must be colonized. Can also be paired with African Power

Lessons of Hemmingstedt.description: As Dithmarschen, hold the provinces of Sjaelland and Holland while Denmark do not exist.
Lessons of Hemmingstedt.completion: Denmark does not exist Own the provinces of Sjælland (12) and Amsterdam (97)

Lion of the North.description: Start as Sweden and lead the Protestant League to victory against the Emperor.
Lion of the North.completion: Is Protestant Lead and win League War
Lion of the North.notes: Has to be Protestant and lead the League.

Live Long and Prosper.description: Have 30 states with prosperity at the same time as you have a 70 year old ruler.
Live Long and Prosper.completion: 30 states have prosperity Current ruler is at least 70 years old

Mansa Musa.description: As Mali, give 10k ducats away to another great power without having a single loan or being bankrupt.
Mansa Musa.completion: Is Mali Has given at least 10k ducats to a great power with a single use of the diplomatic action Send gift Has no loans Is not bankrupt
Mansa Musa.notes: This achievement is only visible if the Origins DLC is active, but it is possible to get the achievement without that DLC.

Market Control.description: Be trade leader of seven different goods.
Market Control.completion: Be trade leader in 7 different trade goods
Market Control.notes: You will need seven different "Trading in X" modifiers at the same time.

Mary of Lotharingia.description: Starting as Burgundy, form Lotharingia and have a female ruler named Marie.
Mary of Lotharingia.completion: Is Lotharingia ruler is female ruler's name is Marie
Mary of Lotharingia.notes: A Consort Regency led by a consort named Marie also qualifies for the achievement.

My armies are invincible!.notes: Research military techs, invest in ideas that improve morale, maintain high prestige and army tradition Finally hire an Army Reformer Easiest as Prussia or Sunda , with their national ideas that give +20% morale.

Napoleon’s Ambition.description: As Revolutionary France, spread the Revolution to 10 countries.
Napoleon’s Ambition.completion: Is France has used the “Spread the Revolution” peace term 10 times
Napoleon’s Ambition.notes: "Spread the Revolution" peace term can only be used by the revolution target against nations that have at least one province the Center of Revolution hasn't spread to. They can also only be used against the country directly attacked with the CB (not any allies). Best done quickly as revolutionary ideas can spread across the entire world, preventing the achievement. Small nations in the Americas, Africa and Asia can be targeted to get to 10 if necessary.

Neither Holy, Nor German.description: Have 7 Free Cities in the Empire, none of which is of a Germanic culture.
Neither Holy, Nor German.completion: Is emperor of the Holy Roman Empire There are least 7 countries which: have the government reform Free City have a primary culture which is not in the Germanic culture group
Neither Holy, Nor German.notes: There can be germanic free cities, but there have to be at least 7 non-germanic ones You can release OPM client states that are republics. Make sure they dislike you before granting them independence, which actually raises their opinion of you. They will then accept free city status.

No Pirates in my Caribbean.description: Own or have a subject own the entire Caribbean.
No Pirates in my Caribbean.completion: Owns or has a non-tributary subject own all provinces of the Caribbean region. Not a pirate republic
No Pirates in my Caribbean.notes: The required provinces are the geographical region of the Caribbean, not the colonial region. Don't forget Bermuda. Portugal is a good nation to try for this achievement. Simply make sure to block Spain from colonizing any provinces in Africa or in any of the islands in the Atlantic Ocean. This strategy should give enough time to colonize all of the Caribbean. With Mandate of Heaven, the "Portuguese Colonial Growth" splendor ability can give Portugal a huge head start. Annexing Portugal with Castile in the early game is also a working method for being the first in the Caribbean. It is enough to start colonizing the province, for it to count towards the achievement.

Not just Pizza.description: Become a Great Power as Naples.

No Trail of Tears.description: Own and have cores on the Thirteen Colonies as Cherokee with all institutions embraced.
No Trail of Tears.completion: Have embraced all institutions Own and core all provinces in the areas: Westsylvania , Delaware Valley , Hudson Valley , Massachusetts , Connecticut , Virginia , Great Valley , Piedmont Plateau , North Carolina , South Carolina , Vandalia and Overmountain Own and core the provinces: Guale, Penobscott, Shatteras, Mocama, Coweta, Sokoki, Kennebec, Passamaquoddy. Expand

Parisian Pasha.completion: Has a government reform which allows Pashas Paris has a pasha
Parisian Pasha.notes: Possible countries are: Ottomans using the Ottoman Government , or its modernized or reorganized upgrades. Rûm via the Sultanate of Rûm reform. Qara Qoyunlu or Aq Qoyunlu with Modernized Turkoman Federation Mamluks via Integrated Ottoman Officials

Poland can into space.description: As Poland, reach the maximum level in all technologies (32).
Poland can into space.completion: Administrative technology is 32 Diplomatic technology is 32 Military technology is 32

Redecorating.description: Starting as an Orthodox Nation, Consecrate Metropolitan in Roma.
Redecorating.completion: Own and core Roma Activated consecrate metropolitan in the stated area of Lazio-Umbria
Redecorating.notes: Orthodox nations in 1444: Beloozero , Byzantium , Circassia , Georgia , Herzegovina , Moldavia , Muscovy , Novgorod , Odoyev , Perm , Pskov , Rostov , Ryazan , Samtskhe , Serbia , Theodoro , Trebizond , Tver , Wallachia , and Yaroslavl Easiest to do as Muscovy

Rekindling the Flames.description: Starting as a Zoroastrian custom nation with no more than 200 points and a maximum of 5 provinces, rekindle the royal fires.
Rekindling the Flames.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Zoroastrian Has country modifier Royal Fires Expand
Rekindling the Flames.notes: Note that this achievement cannot be combined with Keep the Flame Burning because it requires being a Custom Nation, which disallows earning Keep the Flame Burning.

Rise of the White Sheep.description: As Aq Qoyunlu, own Tabriz and have Qara Qoyunlu not exist by 1478.
Rise of the White Sheep.completion: The year is before 1478 Qara Qoyunlu does not exist Owns Tabriz
Rise of the White Sheep.notes: As long as you own Tabriz, any other provinces owned by Qara Qoyunlu at game start can be owned by other nations. Vassal/ally feeding can be useful.
