Iraq has many cores on the required area, and there are several nations that can be released from Qara Qoyunlu's provinces.

Ruina Imperii.completion: There are no countries in the Holy Roman Empire Holy Roman Empire does not exist
Ruina Imperii.notes: Dismantling the Holy Roman Empire requires allying electors or controlling their capital as well as controlling the emperor's capital. Note that the HRE disbanding itself due to lack of an eligible emperor and another nation disbanding HRE both counts for the achievement.

Sakoku Law.notes: By "going full isolationist" the game is not referring to the level of isolationism in your country. Rather, it's referring to the fact that each incident has an outcome of either open, neutral, or isolationist. To get the achievement you must get the isolationist outcome of 6 incidents.

Sinaasappel!.description: Get Orangists in power with 100% Republican Tradition, and owning a province in China.
Sinaasappel!.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Orangists/Monarchists are in power 99% Republican tradition Own and core at least one province in the China sub-continent
Sinaasappel!.notes: Orangist-Statist mechanics require the Dutch Republic (only available for countries with Dutch, Frisian or Flemish culture) or The Feuillant System (only available to Revolutionary republics). It is not possible to get the achievement with the various monarchy and theocracy reforms which have this mechanic( Stadhouder Monarchy , States General , Ganden Phodrang , Dutch Archbishopric , Open Public Elections ), because they can't get republican tradition. The achievement will not be visible unless the country's primary culture is Dutch or Flemish, but it can still be obtained. Colonizing Taiwan counts for the achievement; no need to wait for a Mingplosion.

Sleepless in Seattle.description: Own 10 Coffee producing provinces, and have your capital in Salish.
Sleepless in Seattle.completion: Capital is Salish (874) Own 10 Coffee producing provinces
Sleepless in Seattle.notes: Easiest to complete as a New World nation, as this will simplify moving your capital and help with attacking colonial nations. Coffee has an increased chance to be produced in the Brazil, Caribbean and Colombia colonial regions.

Sons of Carthage.description: As Tunisia, own and have cores on Sicily, Sardinia, the Balearic Islands, the coast of Algiers and the southern coast of Spain.
Sons of Carthage.completion: Own and core the following provinces: Expand

Super Trooper.description: Starting as Sweden, enact the Allotment System government reform, have 80 regiments of Carolean raised at the same time with at least +40% infantry combat ability.
Super Trooper.completion: / Has enacted the Allotment System government reform Has at least 80 carolean regiments Infantry combat ability is at least 40%
Super Trooper.notes: Take quality and innovative ideas for 45% infantry combat ability with swedish ideas. Since only development from swedish and finnish cultured provinces counts towards increasing how many carolean regiments are available you need to culture convert other provinces to reach 800 development.

Swahili Persuasion.description: As Kilwa, convert all of the Moluccas and Indonesia.
Swahili Persuasion.completion: Is Kilwa all provinces in the regions Moluccas and Indonesia follow the state religion of Kilwa
Swahili Persuasion.notes: Uncolonized provinces must also follow your state religion. Propagate religion is helpful however try to keep the Europeans out of the area as it won't convert Christian provinces. This achievement is only visible if the Origins DLC is active, but it can be achieved even without the DLC

Sweden is not overpowered!.description: Own and have cores on the entire Baltic coastline as Sweden.
Sweden is not overpowered!.completion: Own and core the following provinces: Expand
Sweden is not overpowered!.notes: Keep in mind that owning the cores via personal union does not count. If you intend to form a personal union with Poland, be sure to leave plenty of time to integrate Poland (you'll need 50 years before you start the process and possibly several more decades to do the integration.)

Sweet Harmony.notes: Harmonization takes 33.3 years, but events can speed it up marginally. Ming and Korea start with Mahayana already harmonized. Easiest as Ming, conquering some Hindu, Sunni, and Shinto land. It is also a good option to start as Korea, form Japan , then conquer Philippines, Indonesia to achieve this achievement.Harmonization requires owning 20 development of the target religion or religious group. Might be quicker and more fun to create a custom nation with harmonizing ideas.

Switzerlake.description: Own 99 provinces as Switzerland while owning no ports.
Switzerlake.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Own 99 provinces Own no ports
Switzerlake.notes: Can be achieved as part of a normal game and then giving away all the coastal provinces. Avoid expanding into the Holy Roman Empire to prevent high aggressive expansion.

Take that, von Habsburgs!.description: Starting as Hungary, own all of Austria as core provinces.
Take that, von Habsburgs!.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Hungary or Austria-Hungary Own and core all of the Inner Austria , Austria Proper , Carniola and Tirol areas. Expand
Take that, von Habsburgs!.notes: Besides provinces from Austria , also requires taking Istria (130) from Venice , Cilli (4751) from Cilli , Trentino (110) from Trent and Bregenz (4710) from Bregenz Does not require Sundgau (1880), Breisgau (72) or anything else Austria may have expanded into.

Tatarstan.description: As Kazan or Nogai, own all Tatar culture group lands.
Tatarstan.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Kazan or Nogai No Tatar culture group province is owned by another country Expand

That's No Mon.description: As Pegu, own at least 50 provinces that are not of the Mon culture.
That's No Mon.completion: Is Pegu At least 50 owned provinces do not have Mon culture
That's No Mon.notes: This achievement is only visible if the Leviathan DLC is active, but it can be achieved even without the DLC. This can be done at the same time as the Sailor Mon achievement, and will often occur without any additional effort. With Leviathan, the Pegu mission tree grants a subjugation cb on Ayutthaya , which can lead to quite a large acquisition of provinces. The player can also flip cultures to Burmese to ensure colonies are not of Mon culture and can culture convert their original provinces to a new culture.

The Bohemians.description: As Bohemia, own Dublin as a core province.
The Bohemians.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Bohemia Own and core Pale

The Burgundian Conquest.description: As Burgundy, own the Low Countries region as core provinces and have France and Austria as your subjects.
The Burgundian Conquest.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Burgundy or Lotharingia Has Austria and France as subjects Own and core all provinces in the Low Countries region.

The First Toungoo Empire.description: As Taungu, unite the Burman culture group by 1500.
The First Toungoo Empire.completion: The year is before 1500 Is Taungu All provinces in the Burman culture group are owned by Taungu

The Iron Price.description: Restore the Danelaw region to Danish rule, and make it Danish culture.
The Iron Price.completion: Own and core Northumberland and the Yorkshire,  East Midlands, and East Anglia areas. All these provinces have Danish culture Expand

The League of Mayapan.notes: Playing without El Dorado makes this achievement considerably faster and easier since you will not need to reform your religion, which can include decades of waiting for Europeans to show up.

The Levant Turnabout.description: As the Mamluks, have 100 Army Professionalism and annex the Ottomans.
The Levant Turnabout.completion: Have 100 Army Professionalism Ottomans does not exist Own and core Edirne (149), Constantinople (151), Hüdavendigar (317), and Ankara (326) Expand
The Levant Turnabout.notes: Be sure to attack the Ottomans early or at least cut them off from further expansion into Arabia and the Caucasus. You also don't need to have 100% professionalism at the time of annexing the Ottomans. You can just build up to that number later.

The Navigator.description: As Portugal, own provinces in Africa, India and Indonesia before 1500.
The Navigator.completion: The year is before 1500 Owns a province in the continent of Africa and the super-regions of India and East Indies.
The Navigator.notes: It's enough to just start a colony. It doesn't need to be finished. Portugal gets an event to instantly annex Goa if the appropriate mission is completed. The islands of Hollhavai and the Maldives are considered part of the East Indies despite being closer to India.

The Ostenders.description: As Austria or AH have the District and Military Administration investments in the West Bengal area.
The Ostenders.completion: Owns a province in West Bengal area with the District trade company investment Owns a province in West Bengal area with the Military Administration trade company investment
The Ostenders.notes: Either conquer or charter Bengal Delta from its owner. Add it to a trade company and save up 1,200 ducats. Switch to the territory tab. Buy the second building of both the Foreign Influence and Governance Trade Company Investments. This is one of only two achievements which allows a custom nation on the map which can't be earned by playing that custom nation.

The pen is mightier than the sword.description: Have three unions at the same time as Austria or Austria-Hungary.
The pen is mightier than the sword.completion: Is Austria or Austria-Hungary Have 3 personal unions
The pen is mightier than the sword.notes: Austrian missions can give Restore Union CBs on Bohemia and Hungary aswell as Poland, Milan, Naples and Bavaria. Check the page for the exact requirements. Events can also lead to a Habsburg ruling in Spain, allowing Austria the opportunity to claim the throne of Castile, and possibly Aragon and Naples as well.

The Prince of Egypt.notes: Forming Egypt normally requires Admin tech 20, but it's possible to bypass this by forming the Mamluks and completing their missions (this will require becoming Muslim to take Iqta government, though). One intermediate tag that may be useful is Jerusalem , since it gives claims on most of the Egyptian culture lands. You can also play a normal campaign (even form Italy) then release and play as the mamluks, achieve independence and form Egypt at the end. You can go as far to make a backup save so you can continue as Italy normally, if you please.

The Rising Sun.description: Own and have cores on all of Japan as a European nation.
The Rising Sun.completion: Own and core all provinces in the Japan region
The Rising Sun.notes: The Japan region includes Okinawa, Tsushima, Hokkaido, and the Kuril Islands. One possible and relatively easy way to do this is with Spain After you can reach the East Siberian Coastline after getting some colonies in North or South America , get a colony there and start wars with Japan afterwards. Due to their lacking of good military forces and technology those wars are pretty easy to win.

The Sudanese Expedition.description: Starting as Morocco, conquer the Niger and Sahel Regions.
The Sudanese Expedition.completion: Own all of the Niger and Sahel regions Expand
The Sudanese Expedition.notes: For the event see: The Sudanese Expedition The initial crossing of the Sahara can be done by mission so you don't need to take a colonial idea group first. Later, the provinces of Yola, Wukari, Bauchi, and Djado do NOT need to be fully colonized, building a colony will suffice.

The Uncommonwealth.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Commonwealth
The Uncommonwealth.notes: Lithuanias missions will give a restoration of Union casus belli against Poland, if Lithuania are independent after 1450, rival Poland and have annexed all of Livonian Order and Riga

The White Elephant.description: As Ayutthaya, own all of Indochina and Burma as core provinces.
The White Elephant.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Ayutthaya or Siam Own and core all of the Indochina and Burma regions Expand

This is fine.description: Have at least +10 Global Unrest and be in a winning coalition war, which was targeted against you.
This is fine.completion: National unrest is at least +10 Is the defending war leader in a punitive war and has at least +30% war score in that war
This is fine.notes: The national unrest can be seen in the stability tab. Start as England , declare no-CB wars on two Irish nations. White peace them ASAP. One of them shall be Ulster as it controls the Irish part of the strait and it is important to be able to block the strait during the coalition war. Other Irish nations and Scotland should create a coalition against you. Delete your armies. When they declare the coalition war on you, block the strait at Ayshire, then occupy Scotland This should give you enough warscore; if not, beat some of their armies. Wait for the War of the Roses disaster to fire, which should give enough unrest (altogether with war exhaustion and −3 stability). Can be done in 4 years, depending on how quick the coalition war fires.Can also be done in combination with To the Bone Start as Bone and declare no-CB wars on your two immediate neighbours, pillage their capitals, truce break and repeat. When you reach -3 stability stab up once and continue. This will give a high war exhaustion and a coalition should form against you. The warscore condition in this achievement is bugged in versions 1.35 and 1.36 and can't reliably be fulfilled. In some cases it triggers randomly even if the warscore is lower.

This navy can take it all.notes: Research diplomatic techs, invest in ideas that improve naval morale , maintain high prestige and navy tradition Finally hire a Naval Reformer

This Revolution Was Crushed.description: In a war against the target of the Revolution, control their capital and have at least 99% war score.
This Revolution Was Crushed.completion: Is at war with a revolution target Control the capital of the revolution target Have greater than 98% warscore against the revolution target
This Revolution Was Crushed.notes: The Revolution disaster (and the French Revolution variant) is announced in a major event: ' Revolution in $COUNTRY$ ' (or ' The General Estates '). With the Emperor DLC, there can be multiple revolutionary countries, but there can only be one revolutionary target. And it is possible that there is no revolutionary target even though there are revolutionary countries. The "Birthplace of the revolution" icon in the lower right part of the screen shows which country is the revolutionary target. Without the Emperor DLC, A country will become the revolution target, with "Revolutionary" in its name, if its capital is occupied by rebels while the disaster is active. The disaster spawns a stack of rebels, adds +10 national unrest and removes 3 stability. The player can check if the disaster is still active for a country by looking for the +10 unrest modifier on its provinces. It is feasible both to wait for (or encourage) an AI revolution target, or to become the revolutionary target oneself before releasing (and playing as) a powerful vassal or colonial nation.

Total Control.description: Own 100 or more provinces with no local autonomy or unrest.
Total Control.completion: Own 100 provinces that have 0% unrest and autonomy

Traditional Player.description: More than 90 percent Naval and Army Tradition.
Traditional Player.completion: Have 90 army tradition Have 90 navy tradition
Traditional Player.notes: Easiest to do with Utsunomiya as they get -1% decay to each respectively from their traditions and ideas. See the page Military tradition for other ways of gaining tradition.

Trustworthy.description: Have five allies with 100 trust towards you each.
Trustworthy.notes: Can be done as Ming by releasing 5 OPMs (not bordering each other), allying them and waiting for the trust to tick up. Trust can be gained by honoring calls to arms or by using the Influence nation interaction as a great power , or with The Cossacks or Leviathan by trading favors for trust. If neither The Cossacks nor Leviathan are active, trust with allies grows slowly over time.

Turtles all the way down.notes: The most straightforward way to get this achievement is by becoming the Emperor of China and enacting the "Promote Naval Officers" celestial empire decree for +10% durability and getting Naval ideas for another +10%. Combine this with Korea's national ideas (+10%) and their Naval doctrine (+5%) for exactly 135% durability. Alternative sources of durability are: ruler personality  "navigator" (+10%),  Quality ideas (+5%), Humanist-Naval policy (+5%) and Maritime-Offensive policy (+5%).

Victorian Three.description: As Busoga, Buganda or Karagwe, reach administrative, diplomatic and military technology level 32.
Victorian Three.completion: Administrative technology is 32 Diplomatic technology is 32 Military technology is 32
Victorian Three.notes: Most easily accomplished by manually spawning Renaissance, Colonialism and Printing Press, and not expanding too much. To get the other institutions, build manufactories and universities. Researching level 32 loses the ahead-of-time penalty in 1820.

We bled for this.description: Win a war with at least one million dead on both sides.
We bled for this.completion: Won a war with over 1 million casualties on both sides.
We bled for this.notes: Both sides each need to have at least 1 million casualties (attrition does count) in the war details screen when the war leader is peaced out. Allies and enemies that are peaced out before the war leader do not contribute their casualties. League Wars can be a good time to get this achievement if you are the war leader. Protect your allies and don't separate peace countries. Alternatively, you can trigger a big war in the late 1700s after you get strong. Regardless, be prepared to buy down war exhaustion as the war will almost certainly last way longer than it should.

Where are the penguins?.description: As a Malagasy country, unite Madagascar and hold all the most southern provinces of the world.
Where are the penguins?.start: Playing as Sakalava Betsimisaraka Imerina Mahafaly Antemoro
Where are the penguins?.completion: Is one of the following countries: Sakalava Betsimisaraka Imerina Mahafaly Antemoro Own and core all provinces in the following areas: Madagascar Highlands Betsimasaraka Sakalava Southern Madagascar Expand Own or have a non-tributary subject own all the following provinces: Cape (1177) Swellendam (1179) Algoa Bay (833) Xhosa (1180) Wadjuk (1084) Minang (2727) Nukunu (2736) Kaurna (1086) Gunditjmara (2735) Wurundjeri (1087) Yuin (2734) Peerapper (4869) Pyemmairrener (4868) Paredarerme (1085) Tharawal (4858) Ata Whenua (1246) Timaru (1109) Kawesqar (783) Tierra del Fuego (782) Florida Blanca (2869) Falklands (1095) South Georgia (2025) Expand Map of the provinces:
Where are the penguins?.notes: After taking over Madagascar befriend Kilwa to get Feudalism spreading. Take Exploration, then Expansion and colonize the provinces on the Cape of Good Hope. Afterwards focus your attention mostly on the Atlantic islands and South America to get the required provinces before Portugal does, only spreading east when waiting for colonies to finish for reach. Station troops in Australia after the colonial nation forms, otherwise the natives will attack. This achievement is only visible if the Origins DLC is active, but no DLC is needed to complete it.

Wonderful.notes: Easiest done with France as they starts with 2 and can expand into England , Iberia, Morocco and Norway while starting with a decent economy. Alternatively a Buddhist nation in Indochina can do it easily as they have 6 eligible monuments in Tibet and Indochina alone and limited aggressive expansion penalties. India is also a good option as it has more than 8 monuments. One nation to rule them all.description: As Saruhan, have at least 9 loyal vassals with at least 100 development each.
One nation to rule them all.completion: Is Saruhan 9 countries fulfill the following conditions: is a vassal of Saruhan has less than 50% liberty desire has at least 100 development
One nation to rule them all.notes: Saruhan 's core starts under the control of the Ottomans Suggested strategy: expand rapidly as you normally would with the Ottomans until you have ~1200 development. Then, plan to release-and-play as Saruhan, taking most of Otto's lands. To do this, you will need to release Saruhan as vassal, wait 10 years, start to annex (to designate cores), feed it land, finalize annexation, and then release-and-play. You can cheese the release-and-play by feeding past the point of loyalty and then applying all available annexation cost reductions (Acquire Subjects mission, Influence idea, Amirs privilege, as well as any possible Policies). Make sure you wait until the last day of the month to do this, or else annexation progress will drop and you will be unable to proceed. As long as your annexation progress is above 100 on the month tick, it won't matter if liberty desire is over 50%. Once you have reannexed, you will be able to release-and-play. Ideally you will then own almost all Ottoman lands, making independence relatively easy to pursue. From there, you need to obtain 9 loyal vassals (NOT marches, NOT client states) with 100+ development. Rather than directly subjugating enemies to meet the vassal count, it is suggested that the player conquer and then release vassals ; this avoids the forced vassalization malus. To help reduce liberty desire and thus total development needed, choose the relevant policies, and be sure to get the Splendor abilities in the Age of Revolutions (Anti-Revolutionary Zeal + Loyal Subjects). Upon release, you will no longer have the Ottoman government form, and should choose Iqta Then on your goverment tab choose Lenient Taxation, which provides another Liberty Desire reduction. Note that during the feeding of Saruhan and following your transition to playing as them, the Ottomans will likely be severely weakened and thus open to attack. Keep this in mind, perhaps securing treaties in advance or locking in allies (though too many allies for Otto will make subsequent independence harder). Ideally you will be able to secure independence support from a rival.

Stern des Südens.notes: Werder (2778) is in the Horn of Africa region and owned by Marehan at the start of the game. As Munich, take your time consolidating into Bavaria If you can, befriend the emperor and/or electors to make your life within the HRE easier. Once you have a border with Bremen , or coastal provinces in coring range of Bremen, look for war opportunities which Bremen will be called ito as an ally. As they are a free city, it will be much harder if you declare directly on them (as the Emperor will defend free cities). Annex Bremen in a separate peace and release them as your vassal (you can't vassalize a free city in a peace deal). Afterwards, expand in power so that you can combat your most powerful neighbours - Ottomans, Spain, France, etc. Make sure to give Bremen land, either in the direction of the Ottomans or in the direction of Spain. You will have to fight your way through at least one, feeding Bremen provinces to "snake" their land down to Werder (this is because vassals need adjacent land or sea tiles to be given provinces and do not care about coring distance/colonial range). The least time-consuming method would be to give them a province per sea tile starting from the Mediterranean, down through the Mamluks to the Red Sea coast, and finally down to Werder.

Sun Invasion.description: As the Madyas, own and have cores on Tepeacac, Mexico, Tullucan and Huastec.
Sun Invasion.completion: Is Madyas Own and core the provinces of Tepeacac (2628), Mexico (852), Tullucan (2626) and Tlapacoyan(853, formerly called Huastec). Expand
Sun Invasion.notes: You need to directly own and core the target provinces, and not through your colonial nation. There are several ways to achieve this: Move your capital city to North America before a colonial nation forms. Get a colonial nation in one of the colonial regions adjacent to Mexico and grant them a chain of colonized or conquered provinces in Mexico up to the achievement provinces with the help of the grant province subject interaction(or by transferring occupations in a war if they are on the same continent as the capital of the CN). The achievement provinces can be cored as soon as the colonial nation has cored a province next to them. Vassalize a native, take land from some other native including the needed ones and a chain of provinces leading to the coast. Core one coastal province to be able to start coring the 4 achievement provinces. To avoid forming a colonial nation, the cored coastal province then has to be given to the vassal. Use the Unrestricted Conquest age ability from the Age of Revolutions. Simply annexing a vassal in the region won't fire the achievement.

Stardust Crusaders.description: As Japan have the Land of the Christian Sun reform while Palestine and Cairo are Christian under us.
Stardust Crusaders.completion: Is Japan Has enacted the Land of the Christian Sun government reform The Palestine area and the province Cairo (361) have a Christian religion and are owned by this country
Stardust Crusaders.notes: To get the Land of the Christian Sun government reform, it is mandatory to get the open outcome in the incident Spread of Christianity

Sworn Fealty.description: Starting as an Arabian Tribal Federation, unite Arabia and have Maximum tribal Allegiance.
Sworn Fealty.notes: Possible starts are Anizah , Dawasir , Fadl , Najd , Najran , Shammar and Yas The only way to get Tribal Allegiance within the constraints of this achievement is by keeping the Tribal Federation government reform. This reform cannot be selected again after losing it, so it is mandatory to never switch government types (e.g. with one of the tier 6 government reforms or via the first option of the Arabian mission event A New Caliphate ) or do something else which gives a different tier 1 reform. To get Tribal Allegiance quickly as a large nation, humiliate rivals and allow enemies to rebuild armies so you can wipe them for prestige (since battle prestige gives Tribal Allegiance). The Offensive idea group is useful as it doubles prestige gain from battle victories. The Tier 6 reform Tribal Unity , as well as both monuments in Cairo at magnificent tier, give +1 yearly Tribal allegiance each, which will help to offset the loss of Tribal Allegiance due to development (capped at -0.25 monthly at 1000 development).

Terra Mariana.description: As Riga, own or have a subject own the Baltic region.
Terra Mariana.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Riga All provinces in the Baltic region are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects

That's a Silk Road.description: Own or have a subject own all provinces in the world producing silk.
That's a Silk Road.completion: All provinces with silk are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects
That's a Silk Road.notes: Silk provinces stretch from Granada to Kyoto, with concentrations in the Persia, India and South China regions. With Golden Century, Aragon has a mission that makes Valencia produce silk. With Emperor, Milan has a mission that makes Como produce silk.

The 52 Garhs.description: As Garhwal own and maintain 52 forts without going into debt.
The 52 Garhs.completion: Has no loans Own at least 52 forts (level 2)

The Animal Kingdom.description: As Manipur, unite the Bengal region and convert it to Animism.
The Animal Kingdom.completion: All provinces in the Bengal region are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects All provinces in the Bengal region are Animist
The Animal Kingdom.notes: As soon as you can, take on your western neighbours, Kachar and/or Tripura You will not have much luck east from game start, as Ava will guard it's tributaries. Best option is to not conquer both provinces, but to take one as a vassal - and a second OPM vassal in india as soon as possible as well. You can force them to be animist and feed them Indian culture provinces that you conquer. Allies are hard to come by, and vassals will be obliged to help you, pay you, give you extra force limit, etc.. Look for an opportunity to eat nations up north such as Assam, Sadiya, Mong Kawng, and Koch before Bengal annexes them or Ming makes them a tributary. Delay becoming a tributary of Ming as long as possible (or never if you can), but do not be afraid to use it as an inroad for expansion east as Ming will have a lot of tributary states in that direction. Once you are set up, it's the same as any other OPM-to-#1-Great-Power game. Get religious ideas to make conversions faster, especially against Islamic provinces.

The Chrysanthemum Throne.completion: Is Japan All provinces in Japan region must be either owned and cored by Japan or unowned.
The Chrysanthemum Throne.notes: You must start as a Daimyo subject of the Ashikaga Shogunate. The Japan region includes Okinawa, Hokkaido, and the Kuril Islands.

The Freest Man in the World.description: Ensure that no colonized province in the world produces slaves while having the War Against the World Doctrine government reform enacted.
The Freest Man in the World.completion: Has enacted the Pirate Republic government reform Has enacted the War Against the World Doctrine government reform No fully colonized province in the world produces slaves
The Freest Man in the World.notes: Almost all slave provinces are on the African continent (except Azov). Palembang has a quick event which converts them into pirate republic, but they are Hindu and have mediocre ideas. An easier way is to start as Pasai and hoist the black flag: Pasai has better starting provinces, better ideas, and is Muslim, which makes alliance and AE easier. Alternatively, Gotland also becomes a pirate nation through event. Azov and the Ivory Coast are areas of contention with slaves which need to be rushed to asap. Kilwa has the best starting location and missions in Africa. Complete Prepare the Invasion mission to secure five provinces in Madagascar. Move Kilwa's capital to Zanzibar or Madagascar. Give the remaining provinces to Sofala and release the vassal, then Hoist the Black Flag Can be done easily by releasing and playing as Cornwall after you conquer all slave provinces and abolish slavery , e.g. as England/Great Britain, because Cornwall's pirate event requires just 3 ships privateering.  Alternatively, you can cause the event to release Libertatia to fire, as it is already in a slave producing province. Maghrebi nation such as Tunis can sell non coastal provinces to meet the requirements, an alliance with the Ottomans and a proximity to Genoa help gaining Azov early in the game.

The Grand Armada.description: Have 500 heavy ships and no loans.
The Grand Armada.completion: Have 500 heavy ships Have no loans
The Grand Armada.notes: Best done with a high income nation with naval force limit and ship build cost bonuses. Netherlands , Venice , and Genoa are optimal but can easily be done with England , Spain or Malaya This can be done much more easily by debasing currency.

The Sun Never Sets on the Indian Empire.description: Form Hindustan or Bharat and own or have a subject own Cape, London, Hong Kong (Canton) and Ottawa (Kichessipirini).
The Sun Never Sets on the Indian Empire.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Hindustan or Bharat Own or have a non-tributary subject own London (236), Cape (1177), Canton (667) and Kichessipirini (4890) Expand
The Sun Never Sets on the Indian Empire.notes: Kichessipirini (4890) is called Ottawa when owned by a British or English country.

These Banners need a Saga.description: Starting as a Jurchen nation, have 100 regiments of Banners raised at the same time.
These Banners need a Saga.notes: Make a custom Jurchen duchy holding all Jurchen provinces and the most developed states in East Asia. Set it up for high number of states, reduced culture conversion cost, and lots of diplomatic power. Start with at least 1200-1250 development, or face needing to develop or conquer more and wait for separatism to tick down. Form Manchu and then Qing, then make everyone nearby pay tribute in diplomatic power. Everything can be converted to Manchu before 1500, which is enough for 100 regiments and a few more. Admin tech 8 gives 3 more state slots but it is possible without them.

Tiger of Mysore.description: Starting as Mysore, Conquer the Deccan and Coromandel Regions.
Tiger of Mysore.completion: All provinces in Deccan and Coromandel regions are owned by the country or a non-tributary subject Expand
Tiger of Mysore.notes: You need to ally Bahmanis to make it possible to defeat Vijayanagar If you can't, then you might have to restart a few times or no-cb a country in southeast Asia

Turkish Delight.description: Start as Candar and own 20 Sugar provinces between you and your subjects.
Turkish Delight.completion: Have 20 provinces of sugar owned by this country and its non-tributary subjects
Turkish Delight.notes: Fleeing to the new world is recommended, if not required for this achievement.

Venetian Sea.description: Have a 75% Trade share in both the Alexandria and Constantinople nodes as Venice, owning less than 10 cities.
Venetian Sea.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Have less than 10 fully colonized provinces( cities ) Have at least 75% of the total trade power in the trade nodes Alexandria and Constantinople
Venetian Sea.notes: Quickly vassalize Byzantium , and with the help of Austria / Hungary , feed them back their cores owned by the Ottomans early game. You can release Bulgaria so Byzantium does not have as high development. Conquer all the centers of trade and estuaries in the Constantinople trade node and feed them to your vassals. Repeat this by releasing Syria and feeding them back their cores owned by the Mamluks and conquering/feeding Syria centers of trade in Alexandria node. Releasing Croatia helps control the Ragusa trade node. If you struggle with keeping your vassals loyal, develop their provinces, placate them, develop your own few provinces to make yourself seem stronger or take Plutocratic/Influence/Diplomatic ideas. You can drop Crete, Corfu and Dalmacija and pick up Milan, Ragusa or Alexandria. With Trade idea group, diverting trade from your vassals and a lot of light ships, you should reach the required level of trade power.

Why is the Rûm gone!?.description: As Asturias, establish an Order in Rum.
Why is the Rûm gone!?.completion: Is Asturias Own and have a holy order established in the Rum area
Why is the Rûm gone!?.notes: Easiest to do as Ottomans. First, no-CB Castile and conquer the province of Vizcaya, then release Asturias as a vassal. Next, conquer enough Iberian provinces to connect Vizcaya to the Mediterranean as well as at least one province per sea tile connecting Iberia to all provinces in the Rum area, giving Asturias the line of provinces in each peace deal as well as any of your own provinces needed to complete the snake. Integrate and re-release Asturias, selecting to play as them, and then establish the holy order needed in order to complete the achievement. A similar strategy can be used if starting as Aragon, which owns most of the connecting provinces needed.

With a little help...description: As Ragusa, lead a Trade League of at least 5 nations and guarantee the Ottomans’ independence.
With a little help...completion: Lead a Trade League of at least 5 nations Guarantee the independence of Ottomans
With a little help...notes: You can only guarantee a country if you are larger than it. Ironically, taking land from the Ottomans for a vassal is probably the best way to do this.

Yarr Harr a Pirate's Life For Me.description: Choose to play as New Providence and conquer all of Caribbeans.
Yarr Harr a Pirate's Life For Me.completion: Is New Providence Owns all provinces in the Caribbean region.
Yarr Harr a Pirate's Life For Me.notes: Bermuda is in the Caribbean region also. Starting as a custom nation in the Caribbean with the Bahamas as a core, and privateering in the Caribbean will allow you to spawn New Providence extremely quickly, giving you time to expand and colonize much of the Caribbean before the European colonial powers arrive. Pirate republics can declare war on colonial nations without their overlord being called as an ally, so if Europeans begin to colonize the Caribbean before you can finish, it may be easier to allow a colonial nation to form.

Triple the Rome.description: As Russia, be the Emperor of China and the HRE.
Triple the Rome.completion: Is Russia Is Emperor of China Is the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire
Triple the Rome.notes: To be Emperor of China , you must be in the Pagan or Eastern religion group, whilst to be the HRE Emperor, you generally must be Catholic unless Protestants won the league war, or sometimes other Christian denominations given specific circumstances (see League war ), so a religion switch will be necessary to complete the achievement. Switching to a non-Christian religion as HRE Emperor will cause the emperorship to be lost unless the Erbkaisertum reform has been passed, while changing religion as Emperor of China allows you to retain the title. As such, it may be easiest to start as an atypical nation to form Russia such as Oirat , which starts off as Tengri and can use horde mechanics to relatively easily expand into the territories needed to form Russia. It is recommended to not seize the mandate until the needed provinces are conquered since seizing the mandate will change your government to Celestial Empire and disable horde mechanics. At this point, culture shift to Muscovite, Novgorodian or Ryazanian culture and form Russia once you hit admin tech 10. At some point you will need to conquer a Catholic province, perhaps from the Scandinavian or the Baltic regions, which will allow you to convert to Catholic via rebels. After seizing the Mandate of Heaven, convert to Catholicism, then ally or vassalize enough HRE electors to get yourself elected Holy Roman Emperor.

A Sun God.description: Form Inca, embrace all Institutions and own all of South America as core provinces.
A Sun God.completion: Is Inca Not playing as a released vassal Have embraced all institutions All provinces in South America are either empty, wasteland , a colony or owned and cored Inca
A Sun God.notes: The Falklands (1095), South Georgia (2025) and Galapagos (2002) are also part of South America. It is useful to colonize them before a strong colonizer can do it, because these provinces won't become part of a colonial nation. This achievement is very hard without El Dorado, but pretty easy without it.

Academical.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Athens 50 owned provinces have Universities
Academical.notes: Building universities requires administrative technology 17, meaning that despite Athens' extremely hard start, the hardest thing about this achievement may in fact be the patience of waiting until 1622, when tech 17 loses its ahead-of-time penalty. The achievement may be combined with " It's All Greek To Me " to provide a conquest goal to occupy this time, but if doing this, you must make sure to not form Greece until after owning 50 universities, as Athens's achievement requires you to stay as Athens.

African Power.description: Own and have cores on all provinces in Africa as Kongo.
African Power.completion: All fully colonized provinces in Africa are owned and cored by Kongo
African Power.notes: Empty provinces and unfinished colonies are excluded and may be safely ignored. The isolated islands required are: Comoros, Mahe, Mauritius, Île Bourbon, Sao Tome, Fernando Po, St. Helena, Cape Verde and Djerba (but not the Canarias, Madeira, Azores, Maldives, Socotra, or any other in the Mediterranean).

Albania or Iberia.description: As Albania, own or have a subject own Iberia and the Caucasus.
Albania or Iberia.completion: Not playing as a released vassal All provinces in the Iberia and Caucasia regions are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects Expand

An Unlikely Candidate.description: Starting as Mzab, Touggourt or Djerid, reform Al-Andalus.
An Unlikely Candidate.notes: Forming Algiers , Morocco , Tunis or another country will not prevent the achievement but instead only hide its conditions.

Around the World in 80 Years.description: Starting as a Custom Nation of up to 400 points in the British Region, own New York, San Francisco, Suez, Bombay, Calcutta, Hong Kong and Yokohama by 1524.11.11.
Around the World in 80 Years.completion: The date is before 12 November 1524 Own Manahahttan (965), Ohlone (4637), Suez (2315), Thana (529), Bengal Delta (561), Canton (667), and Musashi (1028) Expand
Around the World in 80 Years.notes: Requires Ohlone (4637) instead of Miwok/San Francisco (2021). Provinces cannot be owned by subject , so it is important not to establish colonial nations in North America. Considerably easier with the charter company mechanism from Dharma.

Avar Khaganate.description: Achieve Empire rank and conquer Hungary as Avaria.
Avar Khaganate.completion: Is empire Avaria owns all provinces in the areas Alföld, Transdanubia, Slovakia, Northern Transylvania, and Southern Transylvania. Expand

Basileus.description: As Byzantium, restore the borders of the Eastern Roman Empire in the Balkans and Anatolia.
Basileus.completion: is Byzantium or the Roman Empire has never formed the Latin Empire [1] Own and core the following provinces: Expand

Basque in Glory.description: Starting as Navarra, ensure that most of Iberia is Basque culture before the Age of Absolutism.
Basque in Glory.completion: It is not the Age of Absolutism or the Age of Revolutions At least 32 provinces in Iberia have Basque culture

Big Blue Blob.description: As France, hold 100 European core provinces before 1500.
Big Blue Blob.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is France Own and core 100 provinces in Europe The year is before 1500
Big Blue Blob.notes: Most used route is attacking Scandinavia or Balkans. Make sure to conquer low-development provinces to limit AE.

Choson One.description: As Korea, own or have a subject own all Shinto, Confucian and Buddhist provinces in the world.
Choson One.completion: All provinces following an Eastern religion are owned by Korea or its non-tributary subjects
Choson One.notes: The Eastern religions are Theravada, Vajrayana, Mahayana, Confucian, and Shinto. Due to Ming 's size and power it is best to become their tributary and go after all other nations around before attempting to attack them. The province Kuma (2417) in the Pontic Steppe can turn Vajrayana Vajrayana due to the event which spawns Kalmyk

Cotton Kandy.description: As Kandy be production leader in Cotton.
Cotton Kandy.completion: Is Kandy Be production leader of cotton
Cotton Kandy.notes: The Indian sub-continent already has the highest concentration of cotton-producing provinces in the game, so this achievement is best partnered with The Buddhists Strike Back

Crossing the Finnish Line.description: Release and play as Finland in 1444 and have a direct land connection to the Cape while your capital is in Nyland/Uusimaa.
Crossing the Finnish Line.completion: Finland has been released in 1444 Is or was Finland Capital is Nyland(28) Owns Cape(1177) There exists a land connection of owned provinces between the capital and Cape(1177)
Crossing the Finnish Line.notes: The land connection can go over strait crossings (it is recommended to avoid taking Suez as to not anger the Ottomans ). Finland must be released in 1444, but you do not have to play as them in 1444. Consider making them a vassal, feeding them the provinces required, annexing them, the releasing and playing as them after annexing them. This gives you access to the Sweden mission tree and power base to work with.

Empire of Mann.description: As Mann, conquer all Islands in the world.
Empire of Mann.completion: Is Mann Own or have non-tributary subjects own all provinces which are on an island
Empire of Mann.notes: Mann can't be selected as a country in 1444, you must release it as a vassal and choose the option to play as a released vassal. As England release Mann at the very start of the game. After 10 years you can annex them again. As the annexation progresses grant them your provinces bit by bit before the process hits 100%. You can even move your capital to continental Europe and give London to Mann. Be careful about France as they will likely attack you once you are weakened. After annexation is finished spend all your monarch points to boost provinces that Mann considers as a core. Now release Mann again and chose to play as a released vassal. Alternatively, sabotage England as much as possible, such as releasing all releasable nations, leaving Mann for last. Release and play as them, then ally all other released nations, plus a major like Castile. Take London, Sussex, and Kent in your first war and you should be off to a great start.

First Come, First Serve.description: Starting as a Western technology custom nation in North America or South America with no more than 200 points, unite the two continents.
First Come, First Serve.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Owns or has a core on all habitable land provinces in the continents of North and South America
First Come, First Serve.notes: There must not be any empty provinces in the Americas, but it is not necessary to finish the colonies. Let the Colonial Nations do most of the job; their overlords will usually not defend them in a war. Only native provinces give overextension; this means you are able to annex the Colonial Nations in one war, but do the war before they break free. Provinces which you own don't have to be cored, so you can leave provinces uncored if they don't give OE. When designing your custom nation, by far the most important idea you can choose to include is the May establish Siberian frontiers diplomatic idea, since frontiers aren't limited in number in the same way that standard colonization is: this will allow you to expand extremely rapidly across the continent at the cost of diplomatic power. Be sure to use an Iberian culture, as the Augustinian Holy order will grant you access to free institution growth.

Foremost Servitor of Jagannath.description: Start as Orissa and own or have a subject own all tropical wood provinces.
Foremost Servitor of Jagannath.completion: All provinces with tropical wood are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects Expand Provinces producing tropical wood at game start (orange) and uncolonized provinces capable of producing tropical wood (yellow)

Frozen Assets.description: Start as Novgorod and control 90% of the trade power in the White Sea trade node while it is the highest valued trade node in the world.
Frozen Assets.completion: Have 90% trade share in White Sea and it's the highest valued trade node in the world.
Frozen Assets.notes: Note that "highest valued trade" means Total trade value minus outgoing trade. Not too difficult once you become powerful. You should be able to steer most Asian trade towards the white sea. Trade and plutocratic ideas can be helpful, but are not necessary : trade companies, the Great Russian Federation reform, and monuments like Bam citadel will provide you as many merchants as you need. Building manufactories (not workshops) in downstream nodes like Girin, Beijing, Yumen, etc. will increase the trade value downstream drastically. Note that England gets an event (« The Muscovite trade company ») that gives them permanent +20 trade power in the White Sea ̦; it can be counterbalanced by building lots of light ships.

Gothic Invasion.description: Start as Theodoro and conquer all Germanic culture provinces in Europe.
Gothic Invasion.completion: Not playing as a released vassal All provinces with Germanic culture group in Europe owned by Theodoro Culture is either: Gothic from the Byzantine culture group Gothic from the Germanic culture group
Gothic Invasion.notes: Forming other nations will make this achievement much more difficult, because then all Germanic cultured provinces in Europe have to be converted to another culture to fulfill the requirements. This does not apply if the formed country is a Former colonial nation formable and Theodoro still has provinces in the old world, because forming such a country as Theodoro keeps Theodoro alive so the achievement can still be fulfilled by feeding all Germanic provinces in Europe to Theodoro if they are later vassalized. Note though that playing as a released colonial nation doesn't work, because it counts as playing as a released vassal.

Great Perm.description: As Perm, own or have a subject own the Russian, Siberian, Scandinavian, Canadian, Hudson Bay and Cascadian Regions.
Great Perm.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Perm All provinces in the Canada , Cascadia , Hudson Bay , East Siberia , West Siberia , Scandinavia , Russia and Ural regions are owned by Perm or its non-tributary subjects Expand

I'll graze my horse here.. And here....description: As a Horde, own over 200 provinces producing grain.
I'll graze my horse here.. And here....completion: Has Steppe Nomad or Great Mongol State reform 200 provinces produce grain or livestock

Inner Turmoil.description: Starting as The Isles, own 20 provinces by 1500, none of which are on Islands.
Inner Turmoil.completion: The year is before 1500 owns at least 20 fully colonized provinces( cities ) that are not on an island
Inner Turmoil.notes: it is allowed to have provinces on islands, but these don't count towards the 20. Islands in the context of this achievement means any province which does not have a land connection to mainland continents, meaning any province in Britain or Ireland will not count. Unfinished colonies also don't count. An easy way to achieve this is to wait until one of the berber nations is without allies and noCB them. You can core Moroccan and Sus provinces with extended range from exploration ideas and the colonial range advisor. From there, you can keep eating North Africa, or go to West Africa. The provinces do not need to be cored.

Jihad.completion: Own 500 provinces with Sunni religion Is Sunni
Jihad.notes: Easier to achieve as many new provinces were added to the game since release.

KHAAAAAAN.description: Restore the Mongol Empire before the Age of Absolutism.
KHAAAAAAN.completion: It is not the Age of Absolutism or the Age of Revolutions Is the Mongol Empire

Komnenoi Empire.description: As Trebizond, have the Empire government rank.
Komnenoi Empire.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Trebizond Is empire
Komnenoi Empire.notes: Possible tactics include trying to become the emperor of the HRE or culture-shifting to Bulgarian and enacting Bulgarian Tsardom government, as these will immediately make you an empire.

Meissner Porcelain.description: As Saxony, own or have a subject own all Chinaware provinces in the world.
Meissner Porcelain.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Saxony All provinces with chinaware are owned by Saxony or its non-tributary subjects
Meissner Porcelain.notes: Chinaware appears in China, Japan, Korea and the East Indies.

Never say Nevers.description: As Nevers, own the entire France region as core provinces.
Never say Nevers.completion: Is Nevers Own and have cores on every province in the France region.

New, New Deli.description: As Deli, have your capital in the Delhi province.
New, New Deli.notes: This achievement is only visible if the Leviathan DLC is active, but it can be achieved even without the DLC. Can be done in 5–10 years, depending on RNG. Broadly: get as many allies as you can to deter coalition. Vassalize an OPM adjacent to Delhi , preferably Garhwal or Sirmur to even the AE. Then conquer Delhi (and some needed to connect). Give every other territories to vassals, or sell them to other countries. In a war, lose your capital Riau, after that Delhi will be the new capital.

Norwegian Wood.description: Own or have a subject own all naval supplies provinces as Norway.
Norwegian Wood.completion: Own or have a non-tributary subject own all provinces with naval supplies.
Norwegian Wood.notes: Before patch 1.36.2, it was required that the provinces were owned by Norway or Norway 's subjects, but since patch 1.36.2, they have to be owned by the player's country and its subjects, so the player can form any country and still get the achievement without having to get Norway back on the map.

Quizquiz Pro Quo.description: As Quizquiz, have your capital in the Anjou province.
Quizquiz Pro Quo.notes: This achievement is only visible if the Leviathan DLC is active, but it can be achieved even without the DLC.

Rags and Riches.description: Have the highest income in the world while neither owning nor starting with a province with a development level higher than 10.
Rags and Riches.completion: No owned province has more than 10 development No other country has a higher income than this country
Rags and Riches.notes: One possible start is Norway Stay as a vassal under Denmark for protection, rush expansion ideas, then get exploration after you reach diplomatic tech 7, and colonize Newfoundland from there, triggering the Grand Banks Fisheries which will power your colonial nation of Vinland. After Vinland forms, you can release and choose to play as them well within the time-frame of Denmark beginning integration, bypassing the PU. From there, expand and build as many manufactories as possible, swapping into Canada or Quebec's ideas, or even the USA. An important thing to note is that you can have a 10+ development province after the start of the campaign, but not during the month you're trying to count the highest income. A great alternative start is Wolgast Play the regular HRE game, expanding into Denmark and Russia. Exploit all provinces within 10-20 development (requires Cradle of Civilization), boost development of all provinces below 10. Eventually, your income from flat 10 dev provinces will be the highest in the world, especially if you consider expanding into the west and taking control over the Channel. Keep all high dev provinces like Lübeck under vassals. Another good variant is Kilwa Having Feudalism makes your country a dominant power in region, and you can easily expand. Almost all conquered provinces have development below 11 dev, so you will not need to exploit them (it takes much time). You can get 5 provinces with gold at the start and another 2 in Ethiopia. Other provinces also have good resources like ivory. Also your home trade nodes (Zanzibar and Cape) are convenient for collecting – you can increase income by steering trade from India and Malacca. At the start you should rush to admin tech 5 and get colonists for colonizing coasts (especially Cape) before the Europeans. One way to cheese this achievement post-1.36 is to take the provinces of Iskandariyya, Rashid, Dumyat, and Sharqiya, as well as war reparations from the Mamluks Build Marketplaces in Iskandariyya, Rashid, and Dumyat, and 5 buildings in Sharqiya, as well as ensuring that Sharqiya has been developed 10 times, and then return all provinces. This allows the Mamluks to complete the mission "Highway of an Empire", which temporarily grants them 20,000 ducats, which you get 2,000 from via war reparations. Make sure the Mamluks are able to pay for the construction of the canal, with inflation taken into consideration by gifting money to them before they complete the mission by checking the ledger. For example, if the ledger says the Mamluks have 1% inflation, round that up to 2% and multiply by 20,000 ducats; thus, ensure the Mamluks have 400 ducats in their treasury. On the next month tick, you will receive 2,000 ducats in income. Good starting countries for this strategy include Ethiopia , Ajuuraan , or even Fadl , where you can get the Ottomans to support your independence and gain the provinces necessary in your independence war with the Mamluks. The game does its check for highest income on every monthly tick meaning you could release nations from all your provinces with more than ten development and still get the achievement even if the next monthly tick would see your income drop tremendously as long as on the previous month tick, you had the highest income.

Raja of the Rajput Reich.description: Conquer all of Germany as Nagaur.
Raja of the Rajput Reich.completion: Not playing as a released vassal All provinces in North Germany and South Germany regions are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects Expand
Raja of the Rajput Reich.notes: One possible start is to quickly ally Jaunpur and then call them in against Delhi, who are weak at the start due to large disloyal vassal Sirhind. Take the provinces of Delhi, Sirhind, Lahore, and connecting provinces. You can then reform Delhi once they're wiped out, which will give you several hundred development of cores for free as well as a fairly strong idea set and mission tree. You can later culture-shift and form Mughals for an even stronger idea set and tree. Alternatively you can form Rajputana and maybe even Hindustan With a strong power base, you are ready to expand northwest to Germany.

Saladin's Legacy.description: Playing as Hisn Kayfa, reforge the Ayyubid Empire.
Saladin's Legacy.notes: You will most likely not be able to ally the Ottomans at start. One strategy is to restart until Aq Qoyunlu is friendly, and allying them along with, if possible, Ajam and/or Mamluks and attack Qara Qoyunlu together. You can ally these two at start, if they pick QQ as a rival, and you pick "Lenient taxation" Iqta ability (that gives +1 diplomatic reputation; requires Cradle of Civilization).

Shahanshah.description: Start as Ardabil and form Persia or Eranshahr.
Shahanshah.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Persia or Eranshahr
Shahanshah.notes: It's possible to get Bahmanis in India as an ally by improving relations until you can royal marry them (which removes their "Unknown") relations modifier. This will deter nearby attackers as you expand opportunistically.

Spanish Fly.description: Starting as Offaly, secure a Personal Union over an Iberian nation.
Spanish Fly.completion: Lead a personal union over a country whose capital fulfills both of the following conditions: is in the Iberia region has a province culture in the Iberian culture group
Spanish Fly.notes: Forming Ireland or another country will not prevent the achievement but instead only hiding its conditions. Take a single Spanish province with a core of another tag and release that tag as a vassal. Place dynasty member on the throne and annex the vassal. Return their core via the province screen to release them as an independent nation with your dynasty ruling. Claim their throne, immediately declare with restoration of union CB and enforce union for the achievement. It is also possible to obtain a "Restoration of Union" casus belli on Spain / Castile by forming France and completing the mission French Claim to Naples (requires having the Emperor DLC activated and the Domination not active). Furthermore, if one forms England and follows the Angevin path (requires the Domination DLC), the "Act of the Spanish Crown" parliment debate will release Spain as a junior partner. This works even if the government type switches to Republic during the English Civil War

Sunset Invasion.description: Own and have cores on Lisbon, Madrid, Paris, London, Amsterdam and Rome as the Aztecs.
Sunset Invasion.completion: Own and core the provinces of Lisboa, Madrid, Paris, London, Amsterdam, and Roma. Expand
Sunset Invasion.notes: As a New World country European overlords will not automatically join defensive wars against their colonies by you, establish a power base in North America, then you can either get allies (unlikely as most will desire your gold provinces too much) or an effective strategy is try to trigger a defensive war, or attack a colonial province still controlled by the overlord. In the following peace treaty take European provinces from them, that way you can easily ship over your elite troops in peace time without the need to also build up a large armada. With the Unrestricted Conquest ability from the Age of Revolutions you can take any province making it easy to take capitals without the need of conquering a lot of adjacent provinces.

The Buddhists Strike Back.description: As Kotte or Kandy, own all of India and convert it to Theravada Buddhism.
The Buddhists Strike Back.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Own and core all of the provinces in the Indian sub-continent All of the provinces in the Indian sub-continent are Theravada
The Buddhists Strike Back.notes: Taking the province of Pataliputra will give an extra missionary. The monuments Bagan Temples and Buddha Statues give additional missionaries. If playing as Kandy, you'll likely also get the achievement Cotton Kandy

The Fezzan Corridors.description: As Fezzan, control at least 90% of the trade power in Tunis, Katsina, Safi and Timbuktu.
The Fezzan Corridors.completion: Have at least 90% trade power in Katsina, Safi, Timbuktu and Tunis trade nodes
The Fezzan Corridors.notes: Since you start as a tribal government, forming Tripoli is a good first step since it installs a feudal government and gives access to the Barbary Iqta reform, which enables raiding. Of course, you can also form Tunis and Andalusia for the missions. The achievement conditions will likely require conquering (or at least occupying) much of Iberia to prevent upstream trade power transfers to Tunis and Safi from Seville and Valencia. Moving the capital to Europe (e.g. by forming Andalusia) allows the formation of trade companies in these "weaker" nodes, which greatly boosts the trade power, especially when additional trade company upgrades are considered.

The Great Khan.description: Starting as Mongolia or Great Horde, own or have a subject own the Chinese, Russian and Persian regions.
The Great Khan.completion: All provinces in the China subcontinent , and the Pontic Steppe , Russia , Ural , Persia and Khorasan regions are owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects Expand
The Great Khan.notes: The Caucasia region is not needed even though it gets highlighted by the in-game achievement list.

The Pheasant Strut.description: As Gorkha form Nepal and defeat Prussia with at least 100,000 Prussian casualties in a war (both have to be primary targets of war).
The Pheasant Strut.completion: Is Nepal Prussia must have lost at least 100,000 men in battles against Nepal in one war with both as primary participants
The Pheasant Strut.notes: The game only counts the losses in battles which show Prussia 's flag in the battle list at the bottom of the war overview screen. If there are other countries on Prussia's side, battles which show their flag are not counted. But their losses are counted in battles which show Prussia's flag. Brandenburg or Teutonic Order can form Prussia even when subjects, though they'll still need to be Protestant or Reformed. If Prussia doesn't form naturally, you can create them by vassalizing one of the above tags and giving them the required provinces, helping them grow large enough to field a lot of troops and declaring war on them once they form Prussia.

The Re-Reconquista.description: As Granada, form Andalusia and reconquer all of Iberia.
The Re-Reconquista.completion: Is Andalusia Own and core all provinces of Iberia
The Re-Reconquista.notes: Optimal strategy is to start expanding to north Africa by picking weak targets like Tlemcen and Tunis After the initial expansions, secure an alliance with either Ottomans or Mamluks as soon as possible. Colonizing North America early can boost your income and drastically weaken the economy of Spain

The Third Way.description: Start as an Ibadi nation and eliminate all rival schools of Islam (do not convert to another religion).
The Third Way.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Ibadi No province is Sunni or Shia.
The Third Way.notes: Possible starts are Mzab , Oman , and Pate Uncolonized provinces with Muslim religion (south of Morocco, Tunis and Ethiopia) must also be colonized and converted to Ibadi. With Golden Century, European countries like Spain and Portugal can convert provinces in the colonial regions to Islam by expelling minorities. Those provinces must be converted to Ibadi as well.

This is Persia!.description: Form Persia or Eranshahr, and own Egypt, Anatolia and Greece as core provinces.
This is Persia!.completion: Not playing as a released vassal Is Persia or Eranshahr All provinces in the regions Anatolia and Egypt and the areas Morea , Northern Greece , and Macedonia are owned and cored by Persia or Eranshahr Expand
This is Persia!.notes: Persia can be formed by a nation whose primary culture is in the Iranian culture group, or by Aq Qoyunlu and Qara Qoyunlu Before patch 1.36.2, this achievement was only possible as Persia and not as Eranshahr

Ultimate Military.description: As Songhai, have Prussia and Nepal as marches!
Ultimate Military.completion: Is Songhai Have Prussia and Nepal as marches.
Ultimate Military.notes: This achievement is only visible if the Origins DLC is active, but it is possible to get the achievement without that DLC. Songhai has a strong starting position, the main difficulty is making sure both Prussia and Nepal exist. Note that only Prussia can be formed by a subject nation, so you are better off giving a Nepali minor the required provinces by calling them to war as ally before subjugating them.

Where the heart is.description: As Dahomey, force all non-Fetishist nations out of Niger and Sahel by 1500.
Where the heart is.completion: The year is before 1500 All colonised provinces in the Niger and Sahel regions are owned by a Fetishist nation. Expand
Where the heart is.notes: The owner must be Fetishist, not the province. Possible to do by feeding lots of land to a Sunni vassal and then enforcing religion.

World Conqueror.description: Own or have a subject own the entire world.
World Conqueror.completion: The only existing countries are the player's country and its direct non-tributary subjects and their non-tributary subjects
World Conqueror.notes: Subjects of subjects count as long as they are not tributaries (e.g., Colonies of a client state or Vassals of a personal union). But colonial nations of a vassal of a junior partner don't count, because they are subjects of a subject of a subject.

All Blue.description: As Portugal, all of Europe is owned by you or blue European countries that exist in 1444.
All Blue.completion: Is Portugal All provinces in Europe are owned by one of the following countries: Portugal Avaria Bavaria Bourbonnais Bremen Dithmarschen Dortmund Flanders France Glogow Herzegovina Hesse Imereti Ingolstadt Karaman Landshut Lorraine Mecklenburg Munich Naxos Norway Odoyev Perugia Provence Prussia Saluzzo Sardinia-Piedmont Sweden The Knights The Palatinate Thuringia Trebizond Tyrconnell Urbino Venice
All Blue.notes: Note that Bavaria , Prussia and Sardinia-Piedmont count even though they don't exist in 1444. Make sure that none of the blue countries fulfill the conditions to form something which is not allowed.

From Frankfurt to the Andes.description: Starting as Frankfurt, form Jerusalem, and then form the Inca while owning Mallorca.
From Frankfurt to the Andes.completion: Was Frankfurt Was Jerusalem Is Inca Own Mallorca (333)
From Frankfurt to the Andes.notes: Hardest part of this achievement is finding and fulfilling conditions for different tag formation. To form Jerusalem , you need to get into coring range of Jerusalem area (vassalize an Italian minor and conquer a province next to it), own and state Jerusalem area, move capital to Arabia, Egypt or Mashriq and switch from Republic to Monarchy. And this has to be done before the Age of Reformation ends, because Frankfurt can't form Jerusalem later. To form Inca you need to move your capital to the New World, own cores on required provinces, culture shift to Andean culture and change your religion to a pagan faith via rebels. Switching to play as a released vassal will invalidate the achievement.

Eat your Greens.description: Control all Grasslands in Asia as Kale before the age of Absolutism.
Eat your Greens.completion: It is not the Age of Absolutism or the Age of Revolutions Every province in Asia with Grasslands terrain is owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects Expand All grassland provinces in Asia
Eat your Greens.notes: It is not required to keep playing as Kale to earn the achievement, but changing tag will hide it from the achievement tab. Start by subjugating and allying all Shan minors to complete the mission "Unite the Shan" to inherit them all and gain free cores (don't conquer any province from them as these would needlessly have to be cored; best to fully annex Ava and inherit all their tributaries). To limit AE and help with the endless conquests to come it is recommended you switch to horde government first, which is you should form Tibet and do the "Steppe Politics" mission. Take Horde Ideas then Expansion then Diplomatic Ideas, don't delay colonizing Siberia. The colonies in the grassland provinces don't have to be finished, but you need to finish 3 colonies to reach the farthest province (2 if you conquer Onan Gol(1058) in Mongolia or Albazin (2102) in Manchuria instead of colonizing from the coast). The can be delayed by 30 years by ensuring that the highest valued trade node in the world contains no centers of trade at level 2 or higher, and no capital provinces.

One Faith.description: Have all non-wasteland land provinces in the world be of your religion.
One Faith.completion: No colonized non-wasteland province has a different religion than this country.
One Faith.notes: Using the random new world will drastically reduce the number of provinces, especially inland ones, making this easier than with the true new world. Uncolonized provinces may still be of a different religion. The easiest choice is either Austria or Ottomans , as both tags can conquer the world easily and have religions that have lots of missionaries and missionary strength buffs. The hardest faiths to One Faith with are the Pagan faiths (Animist, Tengri…), and Confucian with Mandate of Heaven If playing as a Fetishist or Hindu nation, choose Buddhadharma or Buddha, respectively, to be able to use the Buddha statues and Pagan temples. Najd is a possible starting nation, since its ideas are religiously focused, including access to +2 missionaries and +2% missionary strength, as well as its starting religion of Sunni granting −2% local missionary strength which would make these provinces harder to convert. Possible to combine with Jihad.

The Three Mountains.description: Own or have a subject own the entire world as Ryukyu.
The Three Mountains.completion: The only existing countries are: the player's country, Ryukyu and its subjects , but not tributary states
The Three Mountains.notes: Note that it is possible to form another country, but only if you do a true one-tag (ruling the world directly without vassals or colonial subjects). If you stay Ryukyu, subjects are allowed.

True Heir of Timur.description: Starting as a Timurid subject, form the Mughals and conquer India by 1550.
True Heir of Timur.start: Playing as Afghanistan Sistan Transoxiana Khorasan Fars
True Heir of Timur.completion: Is Mughals The year is before 1550 Every province in India superregion is owned by the country or a subject other than a tributary
True Heir of Timur.notes: Easier in recent patches than when added. The strongest contenders are Afghanistan , which is the closest to India, and Transoxiana , which starts the strongest. Recommended ideas include Administrative for extremely cheap coring and Diplomatic to manage aggressive expansion and to truce break more easily if necessary.

Mehmet's Ambition.description: Starting as The Ottomans, own or have Core Eyalets own all the provinces required to form the Roman Empire before 1500.
Mehmet's Ambition.completion: The year is before 1500 425 of the following provinces are owned by this country or a subject of type Core Eyalet: Expand Needed provinces to form the Roman Empire
Mehmet's Ambition.notes: Will require patience and knowledge of the Ottoman mission tree and eyalet mechanic , along with related Ottoman events Always be at war somewhere. Muslim nations care very little about Christian nations with regard to AE and vice versa. You will gain a claim on the province of Salento in Naples through an event. Use that to Threaten War and then justify an eyalet CB on Naples. Particular missions such as conquest of Romanian territories and the rest of the Balkans are also vital to be aware of. Always glance at the 'Offer Vassalization' view in the microbuilder, to monitor who can be vassalized, and always keep an eye on truces. Nations can't join a coalition against you if they are in a truce with you. Be very mindful of what you are doing at the present time and why. If you have to be at war with nations outside of the required areas, e.g. Bohemia or Poland , then finish those wars as quickly as you can. Be very mindful with every step and you will achieve this. Influence is an ideal first idea group, as maximising income from your eyalets is a priority.

King of Kings.completion: Complete the Sunni or Shia or Zoroastrian version of the Persian missions

Restore the Pentarchy.description: Starting as Byzantium, own Rome, Constantinople, Alexandria, Antioch, and Jerusalem while being Orthodox.
Restore the Pentarchy.completion: Is Byzantium or the Roman Empire Religion is Orthodox The following provinces are cored and follow the Orthodox faith: Roma (118) Constantinople (151) Alexandria (358) Antioch (2313) Jerusalem (379) has never formed the Latin Empire [1]

Mets Hayk.description: Starting as Karabakh, own, core, and convert to Coptic the borders of Great Armenia.
Mets Hayk.completion: Religion is Coptic Owns core provinces following the Coptic faith: Erzurum (331) Yerevan (419) Melikates (2202) Nakhchivan (2205) Erzincan (2305) Van (2307) Mush (2306) Bayazid (2306) Adana (327) 1 province in each of the following areas is owned, cored, and follows the Coptic faith: Azerbaijan Shahrizor Al Jazira Dulkadir Aleppo Syria Syrian Desert
Mets Hayk.notes: If you can get Mamluks to support your independence, the first war is relatively easy. Once you've grown moderately, try to get European allies as soon as possible to help taking provinces from Ottomans and Mamluks

Desert Power.description: Starting as an Arabian Tribe, have the Oasis privilege enacted, and more than 1000 development in the Arabian Region.
Desert Power.completion: Has granted the Burghers privilege "Oasis Development" Provinces in the Arabia region that have Desert or Coastal Desert terrain: Have at least 1000 total development
Desert Power.notes: "Oasis Development" privilege requires the Arabian mission "The Harsh Desert" to be completed. Note that while not mentioned in the description, only the development of Desert and Coastal Desert provinces is counted for the purposes of this achievement. This means that only 44 provinces are valid to develop, requiring a average of 23 (22.7) development in each of these provinces.

Breadbasket of the World.description: As the Mamluks, export grain to every continent at least once.
Breadbasket of the World.completion: Is or was the Mamluks Has used the "Export Grain" diplomatic action on at least one country on each of the following continents: Europe Oceania North America South America Africa Asia
Breadbasket of the World.notes: To be able to export grain the player has to complete the " Khass al-Sultan " mission. The country's continent is determined based on the location of its capital. To use "Export grain", the target must be a subject or ally of the Mamluks. This can be an issue in the colonial regions. Its thus recommended to colonize yourself.

Truly Good Maaaaa-tch.description: Starting as either Aq Qoyunlu or Qara Qoyunlu, have a royal marriage and an alliance with Ramazan.
Truly Good Maaaaa-tch.start: playing as Aq Qoyunlu or Qara Qoyunlu
Truly Good Maaaaa-tch.completion: Is Aq Qoyunlu or Qara Qoyunlu Has an alliance with Ramazan Has a royal marriage with Ramazan
Truly Good Maaaaa-tch.notes: Can be achieved in a little over a month. Take out a loan, send 50 ducats to Ramazan, send a scornful insult to one of their rivals, then send an alliance offer after a month. Ramazan should send you a marriage offer within a few days.

The Last Crusade.description: Starting as Byzantium, control Venezia, and make sure that the country Venice doesn't exist.
The Last Crusade.completion: Is Byzantium or the Roman Empire Owns core province Venezia (112) Venice does not exist has never formed the Latin Empire [1]
The Last Crusade.notes: Reforming Byzantium from another country does not allow for the achievement.

Legacy of Saint George.description: As Georgia, have as vassals Genoa, Aragon, England and Trier or their successors, and control Wales.
Legacy of Saint George.completion: Is Georgia Has the following countries (or countries formed by them) as vassals: Genoa Aragon England Trier All provinces in the Wales area: Are owned by the country or its non-tributary subjects
Legacy of Saint George.notes: If one of the countries forms another country(e.g. England forms Great Britain ), the new country can be vassalized to get the achievement. If one of the countries dies, care must be taken that the cores don't expire, especially for Trier which is not the primary tag of its culture.

The Zoro-Austrians.completion: Is Persia or Eranshahr Has completed the mission A New Eranshahr mission Has completed the An Asha Empire mission
