Doge Coins.description: Starting as Venice, become the Economic Hegemon.

Veritas Vincit.description: Starting as Bohemia, make Hussite the official faith of the Empire and become the Emperor.
Veritas Vincit.completion: Is the Holy Roman Emperor The Holy Roman Empire's official religion is Hussite The religion of the Holy Roman Empire is fixed
Veritas Vincit.notes: Hussite can become the official religion in the imperial incident " The Hussite Protest ", which gets triggered if hussite countries own at least 80% as many HRE provinces as non-hussite countries when the event The Evangelical Union is Victorious happens. For the emperor to make Hussite the official faith, they must either be a 1 province minor, or be losing a war against a hussite nation by atleast -50 warscore. Since the incident usually immideately triggers once the league war ends and the former evangelical leader will be the new emperor, be prepared to instantly trucebreak the new emperor and occupy them fully. Be quick, as the incident will end after one year.

The Eagle flies alone.description: Starting as Hisn Kayfa, reach a forcelimit of 500k.
The Eagle flies alone.completion: Land force limit is at least 500

Mayapahit?.description: Starting as any Mayan country, form Maya and own or have a subject own the island of Java.
Mayapahit?.completion: Is or was Maya All provinces in the Banten, East Java, Central Java, Surabaya & West Java areas, except Madura (2692): Province is owned by the player's country or its non-tributary subjects

There Khan only be one!.description: Starting as a Steppe Horde, ensure there exists no other horde than you in the world.
There Khan only be one!.start: Has enacted the Steppe Nomads government reform
There Khan only be one!.completion: This country has enacted one of the following government reforms: Steppe Nomads Great Mongol State No other country has enacted one of the following government reforms: Steppe Nomads Great Mongol State countries which switched their government type through government reforms (e.g. by enacting The Great Plains call to us ) or enacted Become Horde are not counted

Baborg.description: As the Mughals, assimilate at least 12 culture groups.
Baborg.completion: Is Mughals Has enacted the Mughal Diwan government reform Has assimilated at least 12 culture groups

Get out of my swamp!.description: As the Netherlands, own all of the Low Countries and have 50% or more Fort Defense.
Get out of my swamp!.completion: The country is or was Netherlands Owns all provinces in the Low Countries region Has at least 50% fort defense
Get out of my swamp!.notes: Defensive idea 5 gives 35% fort defense, having a military engineer advisor gives another 20% , and having 50 power projection gives the last 5%

Timurizz.description: Starting as the Timurids, have 75 prestige, and 5 allies with 100 Trust and 150 opinion.
Timurizz.completion: Prestige is at least +75 Has at least 5 allies with 100 trust which have at least +150 opinion of our country
Timurizz.notes: The allies which have the trust have to be the same allies which have the opinion Trust can be gained by honoring calls to arms or by using the Influence nation interaction as a great power , or with The Cossacks or Leviathan by trading favors for trust. If neither The Cossacks nor Leviathan are active, trust with allies grows slowly over time.

The Hungarian Games.description: Starting as Hungary, win 23 battles with the Black Army against at least 12 different countries.
The Hungarian Games.completion: Any hired mercenary company: Is “Black Army” Is “Black Army Reserves” Has won at least 23 battles with these mercenary companies. For each enemy country, only a maximum of 3 battles are counted
The Hungarian Games.notes: If there are multiple countries on the same side in the battle, only the country which is first in the tag order counts. Doesn't count battles fought when rented out as condottieri. The “Black Army” can be unlocked in the following ways , some of which also unlock the “Black Army Reserves” :
